legal.draft_notice: Draft — this summary describes what the platform does today and is pending legal review.
legal.p_collect: Your name, phone number, city and — depending on your role — company or office details, vehicle details, national ID, bank IBAN and the documents you upload for verification.
legal.p_use: To sign you in, match drivers with jobs, verify accounts, calculate and pay settlements, resolve complaints and keep the platform safe. Staff actions on your data are recorded in an audit log.
legal.p_share: A driver sees the pickup, delivery and recipient details only after accepting a job, and only while it is active. A business sees a driver's name and phone only after the driver accepts. Offices see their own drivers. Platform staff see what their role permits.
legal.p_location: Drivers share their location only while they choose to be online or have an active job, and only after giving explicit consent in the app. Location is shown to operations staff for dispatch and safety.
legal.p_whatsapp: The app can open WhatsApp with a prefilled message to the recipient. You must press send yourself; the platform cannot see whether a message was delivered or read.
legal.p_rights: You can edit your profile at any time and contact support to correct or request deletion of your data. Retention periods are being finalised.

intg.provider.shipox.label: Shipox
intg.provider.shipox.desc: Pull your Shipox orders into JR, follow their status by webhook or on a schedule, and cancel them from JR.
intg.provider.shipox.limits: Shipox lets JR find and import your orders, follow their status and cancel them. Its full status list is not published, so map the statuses your account uses under Sync & statuses. It has no call to set a status, so JR's pick-up and delivery cannot be written into Shipox.
intg.provider.fizzpa.label: Fizzpa
intg.provider.fizzpa.desc: Import Fizzpa orders by their order number, follow their status on a schedule, and cancel them before pickup.
intg.provider.fizzpa.limits: Fizzpa cannot send updates to JR, so JR checks it on a schedule (every 30 minutes by default). JR can import an order by its number and cancel it before pickup, but cannot write its own progress into Fizzpa.
intg.provider.omniful.label: Omniful
intg.provider.omniful.desc: JR appears in Omniful as a shipping partner: Omniful sends shipments to JR and every JR status change flows back to Omniful.
intg.provider.omniful.limits: Omniful sends its shipments to JR and JR reports every status back. JR does not collect returns from customers and never sends “partially delivered”. A shipment you set aside in JR is not refused in Omniful: ask the merchant to cancel it there.
intg.provider.fastcoo.label: Fastcoo
intg.provider.fastcoo.desc: JR works as a Fastcoo partner courier: Fastcoo sends last-mile orders to JR, and JR reports its tracking number, label and every status back.
intg.provider.fastcoo.limits: Fastcoo sends its orders to JR's webhook address, which carries your token because Fastcoo cannot send one in a header. JR reports its tracking number and every status back with Fastcoo's codes; you can change the codes under Sync & statuses.

intg.field.fizzpa.referer_help: Fizzpa requires the website address registered with your key on every call.

iord.none_open: None of these orders is open any more.

route.warn.ROUTE_UNLOCATED_STOPS: {n} stop(s) have no location on the map and are placed last — check their addresses.
route.warn.ROUTE_APPROXIMATE_LOCATIONS: {n} stop(s) were located only approximately from their address.

pb.mode_label: How will you enter your parcels?
pb.mode_full_hint: Enter the name, phone and address of every recipient now.
pb.mode_later: I only know how many parcels — I'll add the details later
pb.mode_later_hint: Book by number, then complete the recipients before the driver collects the parcels.
pb.mode_switch_note: The {n} parcels without details will be removed from this order. Parcels you filled in are kept.
pb.later_notice_title: Recipient details are needed before the driver collects
pb.later_notice: You can publish now with just the number of parcels. Before you hand the parcels to the driver, each one needs its recipient's name, phone and address — the hand-over is blocked until they are complete. We remind you before the pickup, and you can add them from the request page at any time. Parcels you add or import with details below count towards the total.
pb.later_count_hint: Between 1 and {max}. The price and the number of drivers follow this number.
pb.later_count_range: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
pb.later_count_min: It cannot be lower than the {n} parcels you filled in below.
pb.detailed_summary: {n} of the {total} parcels have their details filled in below.
pb.blank_summary_hint: You add their recipients later, from the request page.
pb.review_missing_title: {n} parcels still have no recipient details
pb.review_missing_body: You can publish now, but complete the name, phone and address of each before the driver arrives: parcels without details cannot be handed over. We will remind you.
pb.banner_body: Complete them before the driver arrives — a parcel without a name, phone and address cannot be handed to the driver.
pb.cd_none: Every parcel has its recipient details.
pb.cd_inline_help: Fill in what you have. Each parcel you touch is saved even if only partly filled in; it must be complete before hand-over.
pb.cd_saved: {updated} parcels saved — {completed} now complete, {left} still missing details.
pb.cd_all_done: All parcels now have their details.
pb.cd_csv_help: One parcel per line: the parcel code, the manifest number or your order reference, then the recipient's name, phone and address (separated by comma, semicolon or tab). A header row is optional. Parcels that already have details are overwritten.
pb.cd_csv_template: Download the list to fill in
pb.cd_header_no: No header row — the columns are: parcel, name, phone, address.
pb.cd_prob_not_found: No parcel in this request matches this code, number or reference.
pb.cd_prob_locked: This parcel is already with the driver and can no longer be changed.
pb.cd_prob_dup: This parcel appears more than once in your list.
pb.cd_prob_empty: Nothing to save — add a name, phone or address.
pb.cd_warn_overwrite: Already has details — they will be replaced.
pb.ho_incomplete_title: {n} parcels cannot be handed over yet
pb.ho_incomplete_body: They are missing recipient details. Complete them first, or hand over only the complete ones — the others stay with you.
pb.ho_only_complete: Hand over only the complete ones ({n})
pb.ho_scan_blocked: {code} has no recipient details yet — complete them to hand it over.
pb.edit_partial_note: This parcel's details are still incomplete. You can save what you have now; it must be complete before hand-over.
pb.demo_hint: {n} fictitious parcels for {city} to try the full flow. Tick the ones to add.
pb.demo_search: Search by number, name, district or contents
pb.demo_will_skip: {n} of the selected parcels are already in your list and will be skipped.
pb.demo_over: Only {n} more parcels fit in this order — the rest will not be added.
pb.demo_added_skipped: Added {added} demo parcels; {skipped} skipped because they were already in your list.
pb.api_later_title: Book by count — recipient details later
pb.api_later_note: Send "detailsLater": true with "shipmentCount": N to book N parcels before you know every recipient. Entries of shipments[] may then leave out recipientName, recipientPhone and address, and the parcels missing from shipments[] up to shipmentCount are created as blank placeholders ("shipments": [] with "shipmentCount": 40 books 40 blank parcels). The price and the number of drivers follow the count. Without detailsLater everything stays strict.
pb.api_later_complete: The recipients of those parcels must be completed before the driver collects them: your team does it in the portal (request page, Complete details — one by one or by pasting a sheet). Handing parcels over is refused with DETAILS_INCOMPLETE until then, and the business is reminded before the start time.
rdrv.proposed: Proposed route — waiting for your approval
rdrv.review_hint: We planned the best order for your stops. Check the order and the addresses below, re-optimise if you like, then approve it to start. Recipient names and phone numbers appear one stop at a time.
rdrv.review_note: After you approve, deliver the stops in this order — each stop unlocks only after the previous one is finished. You can still re-optimise the stops you have not reached yet.
rdrv.not_planned: The best route has not been planned yet. Plan it now, or deliver in the order shown.
rdrv.estimate_generic: Distances and times are estimates and do not take traffic into account. Use them as a guide only.
rdrv.warn_generic: This route has a warning. Check the stops marked below, then re-optimise if needed.
rdrv.optimize_hint_pre: Plans the best order again with current traffic, starting from where you are now. Allow location access for the best result.
rdrv.optimize_hint_post: Only the stops you have not reached yet are re-ordered — the stop you are at stays first. If another stop becomes next, its recipient is sent their delivery code.
rdrv.gps_off: Your location was not available, so the route was planned from the warehouse or from your current stop.
rdrv.opt_cached: This is already the best order for where you are.
rdrv.opt_changed: Route updated — the stops were re-ordered.
rdrv.opt_changed_next: Route updated — your next stop has changed.
rdrv.opt_same: Route re-checked — the best order is unchanged.
rdrv.err_conflict: The parcels changed while the route was being planned. Please try again.
rdrv.err_rate: You have re-optimised this route many times. Try again in a while — your current order is still valid.
rdrv.open_in_maps: Open the route in Google Maps
rdrv.maps_more: Google Maps opens the next {n} stops. Open it again later for the rest.
rdrv.maps_skipped: {n} stop(s) without a map location are left out.
rdrv.maps_none: None of the remaining stops has a map location. Use each stop's own navigation button.
rm.title: Route summary
rm.not_planned: The best route has not been planned yet. Tap “Re-optimise route” to plan it now.
rm.notice_local: This order is an estimate from straight-line distances and does not account for live traffic. Use it as a guide.
rm.notice_mixed: Part of this route is an estimate (straight-line distances, no live traffic); the rest uses Google's traffic data.
rm.warn_generic: The route planner left a note that this version of the app cannot show ({code}).
rm.review_note: Check the stops below, then approve the route. You see the recipient's name and phone only for the stop you are working on.
rm.optimize_hint_review: Plans the best order from where you are now. You still review and approve the route before you start.
rm.optimize_hint_working: Only the stops you have not reached yet are re-ordered. The stop you are at stays first.
rm.opt_cached: This is already the best order for where you are.
rm.opt_changed: Route updated: the stops were re-ordered.
rm.opt_same: Route re-checked: your current order is still the best one.
rm.no_gps_note: Your location was not available, so the route starts from the pickup or the stop you are at.
rm.err_conflict: The parcels changed while the route was being planned. Try again in a moment.
rm.err_rate_limited: This route has been re-optimised too many times. Wait a while, then try again.
rm.maps_hint: Opens Google Maps with your next stops in this order, starting from where you are.
rm.maps_next_n: Opens the next {n} of your {total} remaining stops. Open it again later for the rest.
rm.maps_none: None of the remaining stops has a map location, so there is nothing to open.
rm.maps_skipped: {n} stop(s) without a map location are left out.

err.LOCATION_REQUIRED: Turn on location so we can confirm you are at the warehouse.
err.TOO_FAR_FROM_WAREHOUSE: You are too far from the warehouse to check in. Get within the allowed distance and try again.
err.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Add the required evidence (a written reason and/or a photo) first.
err.SIGNATURE_REQUIRED: The recipient's signature is required for this delivery.
err.CASH_MISMATCH: The cash collected must match the amount due on this parcel.

fob.wh_intro: Drivers navigate to this point and check in here. Set it once for your warehouse; you can change it at any time.
fob.wh_radius: To start a job, the driver must check in within {n} m of this point, so make sure it is exactly where the parcels are loaded.
fob.wh_radius_generic: To start a job, the driver must check in close to this point, so make sure it is exactly where the parcels are loaded.
fob.wh_geofence_off: The platform does not currently check how far the driver is from your warehouse when checking in, but an accurate location still helps drivers find you.
fob.wh_paste_label: Paste a Google Maps link or coordinates
fob.wh_paste_hint: Open your warehouse in Google Maps, copy the link or the “latitude, longitude” numbers and paste them here — the fields below fill in automatically.
fob.wh_paste_bad: We could not find a location in this text. Paste the full Google Maps link or two numbers like 24.7136, 46.6753.
fob.wh_short_link: This is a shortened link and we cannot read it. Open it in your browser, then copy the full address from the address bar (or right-click the pin and copy the coordinates) and paste that here.
fob.wh_accuracy: Location taken from this device — accurate to about {n} m. Stand at the loading point for the best result.
fob.geo_denied: Location access is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, or paste the coordinates instead.
fob.geo_unavailable: Your device could not work out its location. Try again outdoors or paste the coordinates instead.
fob.geo_timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again or paste the coordinates instead.
fob.geo_unsupported: This browser cannot share its location. Paste a Google Maps link or the coordinates instead.
fob.val_lat: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
fob.val_lng: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
fob.wh_missing_title: Your warehouse location is not set
fob.wh_missing_body: Drivers must check in near your warehouse, so orders with drivers cannot be published until its location is set.
fob.wh_missing_body_short: Without a location, orders with drivers cannot be published.
fob.wh_missing_dash: Your warehouse location is not set — you cannot publish orders with drivers until it is.
fob.ops_intro: These are the rules currently applied to your warehouse and its drivers.
fob.ops_support_note: These settings are managed by JR support. To change one, contact
fob.op_arrival_on: When a driver checks in, you confirm that they arrived before loading starts.
fob.op_arrival_off: A driver's arrival is accepted automatically when they check in at the warehouse — nothing for you to confirm.
fob.op_loading_on: You record which parcels you hand to each driver, and the driver acknowledges it.
fob.op_loading_off: The driver scans each parcel onto the vehicle — you do not record the loaded total.
fob.op_otp_on: The recipient gives the driver the 4-digit code sent by SMS to confirm delivery.
fob.op_otp_off: No code is needed: the driver confirms delivery by scanning the parcel, and the recipient's SMS carries only the tracking link.
fob.op_signature_on: The driver collects the recipient's signature on the phone before confirming delivery.
fob.cod_hint: Optional. The cash amount the driver collects from the recipient, in SAR (for example 120.50). Leave empty for prepaid parcels.
fob.val_cod: Enter a valid amount in SAR, such as 120 or 120.50.
fob.val_cod_max: The amount cannot be more than SAR 100,000.
fob.cod_total_line: Cash drivers will collect: {amount} on {n} parcels
fob.cod_review_hint: Drivers hand this money to you and you record it under Cash on delivery. It never passes through your JR wallet.
fob.import_cod_help: Optional column “cod” (also cash, amount…): the cash the driver collects, in SAR, decimals allowed. Leave it blank for prepaid parcels.
fob.import_cod_note: Cash-on-delivery amounts from your warehouse system are shown for information. To have the driver collect cash, enter the amount in the parcel's “Cash on delivery” field.
fob.api_cod_note: Optional per parcel. The driver collects exactly this amount in cash at delivery; you receive it from the driver and record it under Cash on delivery in the portal.
fob.proof_scan_long: Delivered with the scanned parcel code only (no delivery code needed).
fob.media_load_failed: The picture could not be loaded.
fob.loading_progress: {scanned} of {assigned} parcels scanned by the driver
fob.loading_by_you: You record the parcels handed to this driver.
fob.returns_note: Tick or scan the undelivered parcels the driver has brought back to your warehouse. You can do this at any time, even after the job is completed.
fob.cash_sub: Cash that drivers collect from recipients is yours. Track what each driver holds and record the money when they hand it to you.
fob.cash_collected_hint: Cash taken from recipients on delivery
fob.cash_outstanding_hint: Collected but not yet handed to you
fob.cash_none_hint: When a driver delivers a parcel that has cash on delivery, the amount shows up here.
fob.cash_all_settled_hint: Everything collected has been handed to you.
fob.cash_history_empty_hint: Each time you record money received from a driver it is listed here.
fob.rcv_note: Record cash a driver has physically handed to you. Partial amounts are fine; you cannot record more than the driver still holds for the order.
fob.rcv_none: No driver currently holds cash for you.
fob.rcv_err_required: Enter an amount greater than zero.
fob.rcv_err_invalid: Enter a valid amount in SAR, such as 120 or 120.50.
fob.rcv_err_max: The driver holds at most {max} for this order.
fob.rcv_remaining: After this, {amount} will still be with the driver.
fob.rcv_settles: This settles the order: nothing will be left with the driver.
fob.dash_cash_due: Drivers are holding {amount} of your cash.
fob.att_hint: {n} of {max} attached · JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 8 MB each
fob.att_too_many: You can attach up to 3 files.
fob.att_bad_type: Only JPG, PNG, WebP photos and PDF files can be attached.
fob.att_too_big: That file is larger than 8 MB.
fob.att_need_text: Add a short message to send your attachment.
fob.waiting_banner: You have {n} ticket(s) waiting for you: support has replied. Open them to read the answer.
fob.st_open_hint: Open: we received your ticket and will reply here.
fob.st_in_review_hint: In review: our team is working on it. Reply here if you have more to add.
fob.st_resolved_hint: Resolved: this ticket is closed. You can reopen it within 14 days if the problem is back.
fob.sup_empty_ticket_hint: Need help? Open a ticket — you can add photos — and our team will reply here.
fob.sup_empty_complaint_hint: If something went wrong with a job, file a complaint and we will look into it.
fob.reopen_hint: Tickets can be reopened within 14 days of being resolved.
fob.reopened_ok: Ticket reopened — our team has been notified
fob.reopen_expired: This ticket was resolved more than 14 days ago. Please open a new ticket.
foa.set_sub: Rules the driver apps follow in the field. Changes apply to new actions straight away and are recorded in the audit log.
foa.set_geofence: Drivers must be near the warehouse to check in
foa.set_geofence_hint: When on, "I've arrived" only works within the distance below from the warehouse location. Warehouses with no location are not checked.
foa.set_range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
foa.set_reorder: Driver may re-order the route manually
foa.set_reorder_hint: The driver can change the order of the remaining stops; the stop they have arrived at stays first.
foa.set_postpone_hint: What the driver must provide as evidence when postponing a stop.
foa.set_ev_text_hint: The driver cannot postpone without typing why.
foa.set_ev_photo_hint: The driver must attach a photo (for example the closed shop) when postponing.
foa.set_wait_off: Timer is off: no countdown after "I've arrived" at the customer, and "recipient unreachable" can be chosen straight away.
foa.set_wait_on: Timer is on: after "I've arrived" a {n}-minute countdown runs, and "recipient unreachable" can only be chosen once it ends.
foa.set_single_job: Hide other offers from a driver who has accepted a job
foa.set_single_job_hint: While a driver has an accepted job in progress they see no other offers and receive no new ones until they finish the route.
foa.set_strict_hint: Off (recommended): every reason can be chosen at any time. On: reasons such as "customer refused" need the driver to have arrived first, and "unreachable" needs the wait.
foa.set_wh_defaults_note: These are the starting values for every warehouse. Each warehouse can override them individually (Users → Warehouse operations); a warehouse that has not overridden a switch follows the value here.
foa.wh_sw_arrival_hint: On: the warehouse confirms the driver arrived. Off: checking in within the allowed distance confirms it automatically.
foa.wh_sw_loading_hint: On: the warehouse hands over the parcels and the driver acknowledges. Off: the driver scans each parcel onto the vehicle.
foa.wh_sw_otp_hint: On: the recipient's 4-digit code is needed to deliver. Off: scanning the parcel code is enough.
foa.wh_sw_signature_hint: On: the driver captures the recipient's signature before confirming delivery.
foa.fin_auto_note: Settlements are paid automatically the moment a driver finishes a job. There is no review, approval or payout batch, so the settlement period and "different person approves" options no longer exist. Corrections are made as wallet adjustments.
foa.fin_auto_banner: Payments are released automatically when a driver finishes a job. An open complaint can put a payment on hold until it is resolved.
foa.fin_sub: Settlement history, withdrawals, the ledger and invoices. Payments to drivers and offices are made automatically.
foa.fin_on_hold_badge: On hold (open complaint) — paid automatically when released
foa.fin_hold_hint: Held because of an open complaint. It is paid automatically as soon as the hold is lifted.
foa.fin_history_note: A read-only history. Nothing needs to be approved or paid here.
foa.wh_intro: Where this warehouse is, and the rules for its jobs. Anything left on "inherit" follows the platform default.
foa.wh_readonly: You can view these settings but not change them (editing users is required).
foa.wh_location_hint: Drivers must check in near this pin. Enter latitude and longitude, or paste a Google Maps link.
foa.wh_paste: Paste a Google Maps link or "lat,lng"
foa.wh_paste_hint: Short links (maps.app.goo.gl) cannot be read — open the link and copy the full address bar link or the coordinates.
foa.wh_paste_ok: Coordinates found and filled in above.
foa.wh_paste_bad: No coordinates found in that text.
foa.wh_view_map_na: Enter valid coordinates to open the map.
foa.wh_err_coords: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180.
foa.wh_switches_hint: Choose "inherit" to follow the platform default, or force a switch On or Off for this warehouse only.
foa.wh_saved: Warehouse settings saved and recorded in the audit log.
foa.wh_audit_note: Every change is recorded in the audit log.
foa.cod_sub: Cash drivers collected on delivery, what warehouses have received back, and what is still with the drivers.
foa.cod_explain: COD cash is the warehouse's money, handed over in person. Recording a receipt here updates what the driver still owes; it never touches any wallet.
foa.cod_readonly: You can view cash on delivery but not record receipts (the cash-on-delivery permission is required).
foa.cod_note_hint: Optional — for example where or how the cash was handed over.
foa.cod_empty_hint: Orders appear here once a driver collects cash on delivery.
foa.cod_truncated: Very many orders: the warehouse and driver lists may be incomplete — use the search box.
foa.cod_receive_note: Record only cash you have physically received. This cannot be undone here.
foa.cod_nothing_outstanding: No driver owes cash right now.
foa.cod_amount_hint: Up to {max}. Partial receipts are fine.
foa.cod_amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero (up to 2 decimals).
foa.cod_amount_max: The amount cannot be more than the outstanding {max}.
foa.cod_amount_server_max: The server says no more than {max} is outstanding on this order. The figures were refreshed.
foa.cod_focus_missing: That order has no cash recorded yet, or it is not in the list.
foa.perm_cod_manage: Receive cash from drivers and use the cash-on-delivery console.
foa.legacy_disputed_hint: Raised before the confirmation step was removed. Handle it through support or a wallet adjustment.
foa.case_assignees_failed: Could not load the list of staff.
foa.case_file_type: {name}: only JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF files can be attached.
foa.case_file_max: You can attach at most {n} files.
foa.case_resolved_note: This ticket is resolved. The customer can reopen it within 14 days; to reply sooner, change the status to In review.
foa.case_readonly: You can read tickets but not reply to or change them.

fod.deliver_scan_hint: The recipient does not need to give a code. Scan or type the parcel code to confirm the delivery.
fod.next_here_scan: Scan or type the parcel code to confirm the delivery.
fod.arrive_hint: Tap when you are at the address.
fod.cod_collect_title: Cash on delivery — collect from the recipient
fod.cod_needed: Confirm that you collected the cash.
fod.cod_mismatch: The amount due is {amount}. Collect exactly this amount.
fod.cod_hint: Hand this money to the warehouse. It stays under “Cash with me” until the warehouse records it.
fod.defer_evidence_note: The warehouse and support can see this evidence. Add what is marked as required.
fod.defer_note_hint: For example: shop closed, the recipient asked you to come back at 5 pm.
fod.defer_photo_hint: Photograph the closed door, the sign or the address.
fod.fail_photo_hint: A photo helps the warehouse and support understand what happened.
fod.arrival_confirmed: Arrival confirmed. You can start loading.
fod.wait_confirm_arrival: Waiting for the warehouse to confirm your arrival.
fod.geo_within: You are {dist} from the warehouse — inside the allowed {radius}. You can check in.
fod.geo_far: You are {dist} from the warehouse — get within {radius} to check in.
fod.too_far: You are {dist} from the warehouse. Get within {radius} and try again.

rpo.def_ops_published: Requests created in the period that were published to drivers (a request is published when the company submits it and its price is reserved). Drafts that were never published are not counted.
rpo.def_ops_fill_rate: Share of the requested driver slots that were filled. Counts requests created in the period that look for drivers and whose staffing outcome is known: requests still open before their start time, requests the company withdrew before any driver was assigned, and driverless vehicle rentals are left out.
rpo.def_ops_fully_filled: Share of requests that got every driver they asked for (the same requests as the fill rate).
rpo.def_ops_fully_filled_d: Requests with a known staffing outcome
rpo.def_ops_unfilled_slots: Driver slots that were asked for but never filled (the same requests as the fill rate).
rpo.def_ops_first_offer_p50: Median time from publishing a request to the first offer sent to a driver, for requests created in the period.
rpo.def_ops_first_accept_p50: Median time from publishing a request to the first driver accepting it.
rpo.def_ops_fill_p50: Median time from publishing to the last driver slot being filled, for requests that got all their drivers.
rpo.def_ops_fill_p90: Nine in ten requests were fully staffed within this time. The slow tail is what customers feel.
rpo.def_ops_expiry_rate: Share of requests that expired because no driver accepted before the start time.
rpo.def_ops_expiry_rate_d: Requests created that look for drivers
rpo.def_ops_aon_failed: Share of all-or-nothing requests ("start only if every driver is found") that were called off because they were not fully staffed by their start time.
rpo.def_ops_manual_share: Share of accepted jobs that staff assigned to a driver manually instead of the system matching one. Offers sent in the period.
rpo.def_ops_replacement_rate: Share of accepted jobs whose driver was later lost (cancelled, no-show or replaced) so a replacement had to be found. Drivers withdrawn together with a cancelled request are not counted.
rpo.def_ops_replacement_rate_n: Accepted jobs that lost their driver
rpo.def_ops_delay_p90: Nine in ten drivers arrived within this time after the start time (arriving early counts as no delay). Jobs due to start in the period.
rpo.def_ops_no_show_rate: Share of jobs due in the period where the driver did not turn up (recorded as a no-show).
rpo.def_ops_arrival_distance: Median distance in metres between where the driver checked in and the warehouse pin (the request's pickup pin, else the company's warehouse). Only check-ins with a known position and pin are counted.
rpo.def_ops_loading_p50: Median time from the driver arriving at the warehouse to the loading being finished.
rpo.def_ops_scan_share: Share of loaded parcels that the driver scanned onto the vehicle; the rest were handed over and ticked by the warehouse.
rpo.def_ops_route_approval_p50: Median time between the loading being finished and the driver approving the route (starting the stops).
rpo.def_ops_job_duration_p50: Median time from the driver starting the work (route approved) to reporting it done, for jobs due in the period.
rpo.def_ops_parcels_per_job: Average number of parcels loaded per job, for jobs due in the period.
rpo.def_ops_stops_per_hour: Stops resolved (delivered, failed or returned) per hour on the road, for routes started and finished in the period.
rpo.def_ops_stops_per_hour_d: Hours from route approval to the end of the route
rpo.def_ops_completion_rate: Share of started jobs (attendance confirmed) whose work was delivered. Jobs still running count as not yet completed.
rpo.def_ops_completion_rate_n: Started jobs whose work was delivered
rpo.def_ops_offer_acceptance: Share of the offers sent to drivers that a driver accepted. An offer that expired because another driver took the job counts as not accepted.
rpo.def_ops_response_p50: Median time a driver took to accept or decline an offer. Drivers who applied directly did not wait for an offer and are not counted.
rpo.def_ops_utilisation: Busy drivers ÷ (busy + available drivers), from the hourly platform snapshots. A busy driver has an accepted job in progress.
rpo.def_ops_utilisation_d: Busy + available drivers (summed over the snapshots)
rpo.def_ops_drivers_available: Average number of verified drivers who were available, from the hourly snapshots.
rpo.def_ops_slots_open: Average number of driver slots still open on requests waiting for drivers, from the hourly snapshots.
rpo.def_ops_cancelled_requests: Requests that were cancelled in the period (by the company, by staff, or called off for lack of drivers), by the time of cancellation.
rpo.def_ops_driver_cancels: Accepted jobs that the driver cancelled in the period, by the time of cancellation. No-shows are counted separately.
rpo.def_ops_late_cancel_share: Share of cancelled requests that were cancelled after at least one driver had accepted, so a driver had already committed.
rpo.def_ops_late_cancel_share_n: Requests cancelled after a driver accepted
rpo.def_ops_strikes: Warnings and automatic suspensions that drivers received for repeated cancellations in the period.
rpo.def_ops_refunds_released: Escrow returned to the company wallet because a request was cancelled or called off, by the time of release. Needs finance access.
rpo.def_geo_avg_delivery: Average time between a parcel being loaded onto the vehicle and being delivered, for parcels delivered in the period.
rpo.def_geo_avg_delivery_n: Total loading-to-delivery time of delivered parcels
rpo.def_geo_avg_delivery_d: Delivered parcels with a load time
rpo.def_geo_cities_served: Delivery cities that received at least one request in the period.
rpo.def_geo_top_city_share: Share of all registered parcels that go to the busiest delivery city.
rpo.def_geo_top_city_share_n: Parcels registered in the busiest city
rpo.def_geo_cross_city: Share of requests whose pickup city is different from the delivery city.
rpo.def_geo_cross_city_n: Requests delivered in another city than they were picked up
rpo.def_geo_unserved_slots: Driver slots asked for that were never filled, across all delivery cities (the same requests as the fill rate in Operations).
rpo.def_geo_supply_demand: Verified, active drivers (as of now, in the filtered cities) per driver slot requested in the period. Below 1 means fewer drivers than slots to fill.
rpo.def_geo_supply_demand_d: Driver slots requested in the period
rpo.def_geo_active_zones: Grid squares (0.05°, about 5 km) that received at least one parcel in the period. Parcels without coordinates are not placed.
rpo.def_geo_geocoded: Share of registered parcels that have coordinates, so they can be placed on the map.

rpd.def_dlv_created: Parcels added to requests in the period, by registration date.
rpd.def_dlv_handed: Parcels handed to a driver (loaded onto the vehicle) in the period, by hand-over time.
rpd.def_dlv_failed: Parcels whose delivery failed in the period and are still to be returned to the warehouse, by the time of the failure.
rpd.def_dlv_returned: Parcels that failed delivery in the period and are back at the warehouse.
rpd.def_dlv_missing: Parcels marked as unaccounted for in the period, by the time they were marked.
rpd.def_dlv_pending: Parcels registered in the period that have no outcome yet (waiting for hand-over or still on a vehicle).
rpd.def_dlv_attempts_avg: Average number of delivery attempts of the parcels delivered in the period.
rpd.def_dlv_attempts_avg_n: Delivery attempts of the delivered parcels
rpd.def_dlv_defer_rate: Share of resolved parcels whose stop was postponed at least once.
rpd.def_dlv_return_rate: Share of resolved parcels that failed delivery and are back at the warehouse.
rpd.def_dlv_return_time: Average time from a failed delivery until the warehouse received the parcel back, for parcels returned in the period.
rpd.def_dlv_return_time_n: Total time from failure to return
rpd.def_dlv_incomplete_rate: Share of the parcels registered in the period that still lack the recipient's name, phone or address.
rpd.def_dlv_b2b_share: Share of the parcels registered in the period that go to a business instead of a consumer.
rpd.def_dlv_b2c_success: Share of the resolved parcels for consumers (confirmed with a delivery code) that were delivered.
rpd.def_dlv_b2b_success: Share of the resolved parcels for businesses (code or signed receipt) that were delivered.
rpd.def_dlv_evidence_rate: Share of delivered parcels confirmed with a delivery code, a receipt photo or a signature, not by scan alone.
rpd.def_dlv_otp_fail_rate: Share of delivery-code entries that were wrong, from the parcel journey.
rpd.def_dlv_far_rate: Share of deliveries confirmed more than 100 m from the address pin, among deliveries with a recorded position.
rpd.def_dlv_time_p50: Half of the parcels delivered in the period took less than this from hand-over to delivery.
rpd.def_dlv_time_p90: Nine in ten parcels delivered in the period took less than this from hand-over to delivery.
rpd.def_dlv_dwell_p50: Median time from the driver's arrival at a stop until the parcel was delivered.
rpd.def_dlv_dist_p50: Median distance in metres between the delivery position and the address pin, for deliveries with a recorded position.
rpd.def_dlv_dist_p90: Nine in ten deliveries were confirmed closer to the address pin than this many metres.
rpd.def_dlv_sms_per_parcel: Average number of SMS messages sent to recipients for each parcel resolved in the period (codes and tracking links; failed sends excluded).
rpd.def_dlv_sms_per_parcel_n: SMS messages sent for those parcels
rpd.def_dlv_parcels_per_job: Average number of parcels delivered per driver job (one driver slot of a request) in the period.
rpd.def_dlv_parcels_per_job_d: Driver jobs with at least one delivery
rpd.def_dlv_stops_per_hour: Parcels delivered per working hour. Working time runs from the route approval (or the hand-over) to the last outcome of the job; jobs under 15 minutes or over 16 hours are ignored.
rpd.def_dlv_leg_ratio: Time really taken between two consecutive stops divided by the planned driving time of that leg. 1 means exactly as planned; it includes the time spent at the stop.
rpd.def_dlv_leg_ratio_d: Planned driving time of those legs
rpd.def_cod_collected: Cash recorded by drivers at delivery in the period, by the time of collection.
rpd.def_cod_remitted: Cash handed back by drivers and recorded by the company or by platform staff in the period.
rpd.def_cod_outstanding: Cash collected minus cash received back, as of the end of the period (today: live). The comparison is the balance at the end of the comparison period.
rpd.def_cod_remit_rate: Share of the cash collected in the period that was received back in the same period.
rpd.def_cod_remit_rate_n: Cash received back in the period
rpd.def_cod_avg_value: Average cash-on-delivery amount of the COD parcels registered in the period.
rpd.def_cod_avg_value_n: Cash due on the COD parcels registered
rpd.def_cod_collection_rate: Cash recorded on the delivered COD parcels as a share of the cash due on them. Drivers must collect the exact amount, so anything below 100% points to a correction.
rpd.def_cod_collection_rate_n: Cash collected on delivered COD parcels
rpd.def_cod_uncollected: Cash due on COD parcels that failed or were returned in the period: cash that was never collected.
rpd.def_cod_aged_value: Cash still with drivers on orders whose first collection is 8 days old or more. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_cod_parcels: Parcels with cash on delivery that were delivered in the period.
rpd.def_cod_share: Share of the parcels registered in the period that carry cash on delivery.
rpd.def_cod_failed: COD parcels that failed or were returned in the period.
rpd.def_cod_mismatch: Delivered COD parcels whose recorded cash differs from the amount due. Drivers cannot confirm another amount, so each one is a correction to investigate.
rpd.def_cod_aged_orders: Orders where the driver still holds cash and the first collection is 8 days old or more. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_cod_holders: Drivers who hold cash-on-delivery money that has not been received back. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.kpi_cod_lag_p50: Median time to hand cash back
rpd.def_cod_lag_p50: Median time from the driver's latest collection on an order to the moment the cash was received, for receipts recorded in the period.
rpd.def_cod_lag_p90: Nine in ten receipts recorded in the period came faster than this after the driver's latest collection on the order.
rpd.def_fin_billed: Total billed to businesses on settlements created in the period. Prices include VAT. Rejected settlements are excluded.
rpd.def_fin_vat: VAT contained in the billed amount (extracted at the VAT rate in force), on settlements created in the period.
rpd.def_fin_net_sales: Billed amount minus the VAT it contains.
rpd.def_fin_provider: Amount owed to drivers and courier offices for the settled work, on settlements created in the period.
rpd.def_fin_revenue: Billed amount minus provider cost, on settlements created in the period. It still contains the VAT.
rpd.def_fin_margin_pct: Share of the billed amount that the platform keeps, before VAT.
rpd.def_fin_net_position: Platform margin minus the VAT contained in the billed amount: what remains once the VAT is set aside.
rpd.def_fin_aov: Average billed amount of a request settled in the period.
rpd.def_fin_aov_d: Requests with a settlement in the period
rpd.def_fin_rev_per_request: Average platform margin of a request settled in the period.
rpd.def_fin_rev_per_request_d: Requests with a settlement in the period
rpd.def_fin_rev_per_parcel: Platform margin of the period divided by the parcels delivered in the period (settlement and delivery dates can differ slightly).
rpd.def_fin_settlements: Settlements created in the period, rejected ones excluded.
rpd.def_fin_concentration: Share of the billed amount that comes from the ten largest companies. A high share means a few companies carry the revenue.
rpd.def_fin_concentration_n: Billed amount of the ten largest companies
rpd.def_fin_payout_office: Provider cost of the settlements whose payee is a courier office.
rpd.def_fin_payout_direct: Provider cost of the settlements paid straight to independent drivers.
rpd.def_fin_settle_latency: Average time from a settlement's creation to its payment, for the settlements created in the period that are paid.
rpd.def_fin_settle_latency_n: Total time from creation to payment
rpd.def_fin_settle_latency_d: Paid settlements created in the period
rpd.def_fin_settle_unpaid: Settlements that are neither paid nor rejected. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_fin_settle_held: Unpaid settlements held back by an open complaint that holds the money. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_fin_wd_requested: Amount that drivers and offices asked to withdraw to their bank in the period.
rpd.def_fin_wd_paid: Amount of the withdrawals paid in the period, by the time of the decision.
rpd.def_fin_wd_rejected: Amount of the withdrawals rejected in the period, by the time of the decision.
rpd.def_fin_wd_turnaround: Average time from the request to the decision (paid or rejected), for withdrawals decided in the period.
rpd.def_fin_wd_turnaround_n: Total time from request to decision
rpd.def_fin_wd_pending: Amount of the withdrawal requests that are pending or approved but not paid. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_fin_topups: Money added to wallets in the period. Simulated demo payments are included while the platform runs in demo mode.
rpd.def_fin_wallet_liability: What the platform owes wallet holders: positive balances plus held withdrawals plus escrow, at the end of the period (today: live).
rpd.def_fin_escrow: Money reserved for requests that are not settled yet, at the end of the period (today: live).
rpd.def_fin_cash_drivers: Cash-on-delivery money collected and not yet received back, at the end of the period (today: live).
rpd.def_fin_credit_used: Total negative balance of the companies using their credit facility. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_fin_credit_util: Share of the approved credit limits that is in use. As of now; the period does not apply.
rpd.def_fin_invoices: Invoices issued in the period (one per paid settlement).
rpd.def_fin_invoiced: Total of the invoices issued in the period, VAT included.
rpd.def_fin_cancel_refunds: Reserved money returned to businesses because a request or a parcel was cancelled in the period.
rpd.def_fin_settle_refunds: Part of the reserved money that was not used and went back to the business when the settlement was created (fewer final units than expected).
rpd.def_fin_adjustments: Manual credits minus manual debits that staff applied to wallets in the period.
rpp.cmp_subtitle: Who orders, how often and who is slipping away: activity, retention, concentration, health and churn of the business accounts.
rpp.def_cmp_new: Companies whose first request ever (drafts excluded) was created in the period.
rpp.def_cmp_returning: Companies that placed a request in the period and had already ordered before the period started.
rpp.def_cmp_churned: Companies that ordered before but have placed no request for 60 days or more at the end of the period. The 30-day and 90-day counts are shown under the number.
rpp.def_cmp_at_risk: Companies with at least 2 requests in total that have been silent for 14 to 59 days at the end of the period: not lost yet, but slipping.
rpp.def_cmp_orders_per: Average number of requests an active company created in the period.
rpp.def_cmp_parcels_per: Average number of parcels an active company registered in the period.
rpp.def_cmp_cod_share: Share of the parcels registered in the period that carry cash to collect on delivery.
rpp.def_cmp_api_share: Share of requests created through the API (warehouse systems and integrations) rather than the website or the mobile app.
rpp.def_cmp_repeat: Share of the active companies that placed two or more requests in the period.
rpp.def_cmp_order_gap: Median time between two consecutive requests of the same company, both inside the period. A shorter gap means companies order more often.
rpp.def_cmp_credit_util: Credit in use (negative wallet balances) as a share of the credit limits granted. Balances are read now, not for the period; only the company filter narrows them.
rpp.def_cmp_verified: Share of the active companies whose account is verified (state now).
rpp.def_cmp_located: Share of the active companies that have set their warehouse location, which drivers need to check in on arrival (state now).
rpp.def_cmp_located_n: Active companies with a warehouse location
rpp.cmp_activity_hint: Per period: companies that ordered, companies placing their first request, and company accounts created. The dashed lines are the comparison period.
rpp.cmp_pareto_hint: The ten largest companies hold {n} of the total. Bars: each company; line: running share.
rpp.cmp_cohorts_hint: Of the companies that signed up in a month, the share that placed a request in each following month.
rpp.cohort_note: Columns are months since signup (0 = the signup month). Only requests matching the filters count; the last column of each row is cut at the end of the period.
rpp.cmp_segments_hint: Size = parcels registered per 30 days in the period.
rpp.cmp_channels_hint: Requests by channel: website, API or mobile app.
rpp.cmp_health_hint: Companies that ordered in the last {d} days, by score (0 to 100).
rpp.hs_title: How the health score is calculated
rpp.hs_hint: A transparent 0 to 100 score; every component is 0 to 1 and weighted.
rpp.hs_recency: Recency ({w}): 1 for a company that ordered today, falling to 0 after {d} days without a request.
rpp.hs_frequency: Frequency ({w}): requests per 30 days against a target of {n}, capped at 1.
rpp.hs_success: Delivery success ({w}): parcels delivered ÷ parcels resolved.
rpp.hs_support: Support issues ({w}): 1 minus (tickets and complaints opened ÷ requests, capped at 1). Tickets and complaints are counted for the period and only the company filter narrows them.
rpp.hs_missing: A component without data (no resolved parcels, no requests) is left out and the other weights are scaled up, so missing data never counts as a zero.
rpp.hs_bands: Healthy from {good}, watch from {watch}, at risk below.
rpp.cmp_wallets_hint: Company wallets now, by available balance. Overdrawn = using the credit limit.
rpp.ins_sparse: Companies that ordered in this period: {n}. With so few, shares and averages can swing widely.
rpp.ins_top10: The ten largest companies hold {n}% of the total.
rpp.ins_churn_up: Companies silent for 60 days or more are up by {n} against the end of the comparison period.
rpp.ins_at_risk: Companies slipping away (no request for 14 to 59 days): {n}. See the list below.
rpp.ins_mostly_new: {n}% of the active companies placed their very first request in this period.
rpp.ins_repeat_low: Only {n}% of the active companies ordered more than once.
rpp.ins_health_low: {n}% of the companies that ordered recently have a low health score.
rpp.ins_api_none: No request came through the API: no company is integrated yet.
rpp.ins_api_high: {n}% of the requests come through the API: integrations are carrying the volume.
rpp.ins_credit_high: Companies use {n}% of the credit they were granted.
rpp.ins_unverified: Active companies that are not verified: {n}.

rpp.drv_subtitle: The driver fleet and its quality: who is working, how reliably, how fast they answer, what they earn and where supply is thin.
rpp.def_flt_available: Verified, active drivers who have set themselves available right now and are not suspended. A state now, not for the period.
rpp.def_flt_online_hours: Total time drivers were available in the period, from the availability log (every switch to available until the next switch).
rpp.def_flt_jobs_per: Average number of jobs an active driver kept in the period (accepted and not cancelled, replaced or no-show).
rpp.def_flt_parcels_per: Average number of parcels an active driver delivered in the period.
rpp.def_flt_success: Share of the resolved parcels carried by drivers that were delivered. Parcels still in the pool, without a driver, are not counted.
rpp.def_flt_acceptance: Share of the offers the platform sent to drivers (created in the period) that drivers accepted, among those answered (accepted, rejected or expired). Offers still waiting and applications drivers made themselves are left out.
rpp.def_flt_resp_p50: Median time from an offer being sent to the driver accepting it, over the offers that were accepted.
rpp.def_flt_resp_p90: Nine in ten accepted offers were accepted within this time.
rpp.def_flt_cancel: Share of the jobs accepted in the period that the driver later cancelled or did not show up for. A job cancelled because the request was cancelled does not count.
rpp.def_flt_cancel_n: Jobs cancelled by the driver or no-show
rpp.def_flt_replaced: Share of the jobs accepted in the period from which operations or the office replaced the driver.
rpp.def_flt_replaced_n: Jobs where the driver was replaced
rpp.def_flt_rating: Average stars (1 to 5) of the ratings drivers received from businesses in the period.
rpp.def_flt_earn_per: Average provider amount settled per driver who earned something in the period (paid to the driver or to the driver's office).
rpp.def_flt_earn_hour: Provider amount settled in the period divided by the hours drivers were available. Online time is not narrowed by request filters.
rpp.def_flt_util: Share of online time spent working. For each driver: the time from arriving at a job to its final report (at most 16 hours a job), capped at their online time. Online time is not narrowed by request filters.
rpp.def_flt_cash: Cash on delivery that drivers collected minus what they have handed back, now, for parcels matching the filters.
rpp.def_flt_strikes: Jobs that drivers cancelled themselves, accepted in the period. Each one counts toward the cancellation policy.
rpp.def_flt_suspensions: Drivers suspended automatically by the cancellation policy in the period (from the availability log).
rpp.def_flt_churned: Drivers who accepted a job in the previous period (the comparison period, or the period of the same length before) but none in this one.
rpp.def_flt_flagged: Drivers with activity in the period who trip at least one reliability rule (see the rules and the list below).
rpp.drv_volume_hint: Per period: drivers who accepted a job, jobs kept, parcels delivered and driver accounts created.
rpp.drv_quality_hint: Offer acceptance, delivery success and cancellation + no-show rate per period. A gap means nothing was due.
rpp.drv_dist_jobs_hint: Active drivers by the number of jobs they kept in the period.
rpp.drv_dist_success_hint: Drivers with at least 5 resolved parcels, by their delivery success.
rpp.drv_dist_rating_hint: How many ratings of each star value drivers received in the period.
rpp.drv_leaders_hint: Drivers with at least {n} resolved parcels, so a lucky or unlucky handful cannot rank.
rpp.drv_reliability_hint: Drivers with at least 3 answered offers and 3 jobs. Rows: share of offers accepted; columns: share of accepted jobs finished (not cancelled, no-show or replaced).
rpp.drv_heat_hint: Average number of drivers available per weekday and hour (Riyadh time), over the last {n} days of the period.
rpp.heat_src_snapshots: Source: hourly platform snapshots (the availability log has no data). Driver and office filters do not narrow it.
rpp.drv_funnel_hint: Of the drivers who registered in the period, how many got through each step. Steps are measured up to now.
rpp.drv_rules_hint: A driver is flagged for a reason only with enough volume behind it. The list below shows the most serious reason and how many rules they trip.
rpp.rule_high_cancel: Cancellation and no-show rate of {n}% or more, with at least {v} jobs.
rpp.rule_low_success: Delivery success under {n}%, with at least {v} resolved parcels.
rpp.rule_low_ontime: On-time start under {n}%, with at least {v} jobs due.
rpp.rule_low_acceptance: Offer acceptance under {n}%, with at least {v} answered offers.
rpp.rule_low_rating: Average rating under {n}, with at least {v} ratings.
rpp.ins_drv_sparse: Drivers with a job in this period: {n}. With so few, rates can swing widely.
rpp.ins_drv_flagged: Drivers who trip a reliability rule: {n}. See the list below.
rpp.ins_drv_acceptance_low: Drivers accept only {n}% of the offers they answer: matching is spending effort on offers nobody takes.
rpp.ins_drv_cancel_high: {n}% of accepted jobs end in a driver cancellation or no-show.
rpp.ins_drv_success_low: Delivery success of drivers is {n}%, below 90%.
rpp.ins_drv_ontime_low: Only {n}% of jobs start on time.
rpp.ins_drv_util_low: Drivers spend only {n}% of their online time working: there is more supply than work.
rpp.ins_drv_churned: Drivers who worked before but not in this period: {n}.
rpp.ins_drv_none_available: No driver is available right now.
rpp.ins_drv_peak: Most drivers are available on {day} around {hour}.
rpp.ins_drv_ratings_low: {n}% of the ratings drivers received are 1 or 2 stars.
rpp.ins_drv_cash: Drivers are holding cash on delivery that has not been handed back yet.

rpp.off_subtitle: How courier offices run their fleets: drivers, work, quality, earnings and payouts, agreements and driver turnover.
rpp.def_cof_active: Courier offices whose drivers accepted at least one job in the period.
rpp.def_cof_fleet: Drivers linked to a courier office now. A state now, not for the period; request filters do not narrow it.
rpp.def_cof_active_drivers: Distinct drivers who accepted a job for a courier office in the period. Work is credited to the office the driver belonged to when the offer was made.
rpp.def_cof_jobs: Jobs accepted in the period by drivers of courier offices and not cancelled, replaced or no-show.
rpp.def_cof_parcels: Parcels delivered in the period by drivers of courier offices, by delivery time.
rpp.def_cof_success: Share of the resolved parcels carried by office drivers that were delivered.
rpp.def_cof_ontime: Share of the jobs of office drivers that started on time: the driver arrived by the start time plus the allowed grace. A no-show counts as late.
rpp.def_cof_ontime_n: Jobs where the driver arrived on time
rpp.def_cof_rating: Average stars (1 to 5) of the ratings office drivers received in the period.
rpp.def_cof_util: Share of the affiliated drivers who worked in the period. For each office at most its fleet size; the fleet is read now, so this is least reliable for long periods.
rpp.def_cof_util_n: Drivers who worked (per office, at most its fleet)
rpp.def_cof_earned: Provider amount of the settlements paid to courier offices, by settlement date (rejected settlements excluded).
rpp.def_cof_paid: Settlements to courier offices that were paid out in the period, by payment date.

rpr.def_biz_deferred_rate_n: Resolved parcels postponed at least once
rpr.def_biz_delivery_time: Median time from hand-over to the driver until delivery, for parcels delivered in the period.
rpr.def_biz_otp_issue_rate: Share of resolved parcels where the recipient entered a wrong code or had no code.
rpr.def_biz_otp_issue_rate_n: Parcels with a wrong code or no code
rpr.def_biz_sms_failure_rate: Share of the delivery-code and tracking messages sent to your recipients that failed.
rpr.def_biz_returns_outstanding: Failed parcels not yet marked as received back at your warehouse, as of now whatever the period.
rpr.def_biz_orders_billed: Orders with a settlement created in the period (rejected settlements excluded).
rpr.def_biz_invoiced: Total of the tax invoices issued in the period, VAT included.
rpr.def_biz_vat: The VAT included in the invoices issued in the period.
rpr.def_biz_topups: Money you added to your wallet in the period.
rpr.def_biz_wallet_balance: Your available wallet balance now. A negative balance is credit in use.
rpr.def_biz_credit_usage: Share of your approved credit limit that is in use right now (balance below zero).
rpr.def_biz_credit_usage_n: Credit in use (the amount below zero)
rpr.def_biz_forecast: An estimate of what you will be charged over the next 30 days, projected from your average daily spending over the last 28 days. It is not a promise and needs spending on at least 3 of those days.
rpr.def_off_drivers: Drivers linked to your office now.
rpr.def_off_jobs: Jobs your drivers accepted in the period, by acceptance time.
rpr.def_off_completion_rate: Share of finished jobs that were completed. A job is finished when it is completed, a no-show, cancelled by the driver or replaced.
rpr.def_off_completion_rate_d: Completed + no-show + cancelled by the driver + replaced jobs
rpr.def_off_utilisation: Share of the drivers linked to your office who took at least one job in the period.
rpr.def_off_utilisation_n: Linked drivers who took a job in the period
rpr.def_off_utilisation_d: Drivers linked to your office now
rpr.def_off_rating: Average stars that companies gave your drivers for their jobs, by the time of the rating in the period.
rpr.def_off_earnings: What your office earned: the payout amount of the settlements created in the period (rejected settlements excluded).
rpr.def_off_paid: Settlement amounts paid into your wallet in the period, by payment time.
rpr.def_off_pending: Settlements that are not paid and not rejected, as of now whatever the period.
rpr.def_off_acceptance_rate: Share of the automatic offers made to your drivers in the period, and already answered, that were accepted.
rpr.def_off_no_show_rate: Share of the jobs taken in the period where the driver did not show up.
rpr.def_off_cancel_rate: Share of the jobs taken in the period that the driver cancelled. Cancellations caused by the company or the platform are not counted.
rpr.def_off_avg_jobs: Average number of jobs per driver who took at least one job in the period.
rpr.def_off_avg_jobs_d: Drivers who took at least one job
rpr.def_off_coach: Drivers with at least one coaching flag (low delivery success, late arrivals, no-shows, cancellations, low rating, low offer acceptance), each only when enough work stands behind it.
rpr.def_off_avg_per_job: Average payout amount per settlement created in the period.
rpr.def_off_avg_per_parcel: Average payout per parcel on delivery-driver settlements created in the period.
rpr.def_off_withdrawn: Withdrawals paid out to your bank in the period, by payment time.
rpr.def_off_withdrawals_pending: Withdrawals requested and not yet paid or rejected, as of now.
rpr.def_off_time_to_pay: Average time from the creation of a settlement to its payment, for settlements paid in the period.
rpr.def_off_time_to_pay_n: Total waiting time of the settlements paid
rpr.def_off_settlements: Settlements created in the period (rejected settlements excluded).

acr.card_office_d: A fleet manager that assigns jobs to its own drivers.

acr.card_office_3: A fleet it can invite drivers into
acr.card_driver_d: A driver with a vehicle who takes jobs.

acr.card_driver_3: Starts unavailable until they go online in the app

acr.sec_company_hint: How the company appears on orders, invoices and lists.
acr.sec_office_hint: How the office appears in agreements, settlements and lists.
acr.sec_vehicle_hint: What the driver drives and which services they can be matched to.
acr.sec_location_hint: Drivers must be near this pin to check in at the warehouse.
acr.sec_bank_hint: Where withdrawals and payouts are sent. Changing the IBAN notifies the account owner.
acr.sec_access_hint: How the account starts and how the person is told.
acr.language_hint: Language of the app and messages for this person.
acr.contact_person_hint: If different from the account holder.
acr.email_hint: Optional. Used for invoices and notifications.
acr.phone_hint: Saudi mobile, e.g. 05XXXXXXXX. A contact number — it is not the sign-in name.
acr.phone_keep: Leave empty to keep the current number ({phone}).

acr.office_affiliation_hint: Optional. The driver joins this office's fleet right away, as if they had accepted its invitation.

acr.office_edit_direct: Direct driver (no office). A courier office can invite them from its portal.
acr.pin_locked: Moving the warehouse location needs the “users.edit” permission.
acr.pin_later: You can leave this empty now. Drivers cannot check in at the warehouse until the location is set — add it later from the company's Warehouse tab.
acr.verify_pending_hint: Documents go through the normal review before the company can publish orders.
acr.verify_pending_driver_hint: Documents go through the normal review before the driver can take jobs.
acr.verify_now_hint: Skip the review. A reason is required and kept in the audit log.

acr.send_sms_hint: Sends one text message to this number. Creating the account never depends on it.
acr.summary_hint: Nothing is saved until you press Create.

acr.will_verified: The account is marked verified now and your reason is recorded.

acr.will_office: The driver joins the fleet of {office}.
acr.will_pin_set: The warehouse location is set, so drivers can check in.
acr.will_pin_missing: No warehouse location yet — set it before the company publishes orders.
acr.will_terms: The person accepts the terms the first time they are needed (publishing an order or taking a job).

acr.warn_pin_change: Open orders that used the old warehouse location move to the new one.
acr.audit_note: Every change is recorded in the audit log with the old and new values.

acr.sms_sent: A text message with the sign-in instructions was sent.
acr.sms_demo: Demo mode: no real text message was sent.

dv1.order_not_found_hint: This link does not lead to an order you can open. It may have been mistyped.
dv1.def_slots: Driver slots filled out of the slots the order needs. A slot counts while a driver who accepted is still on the job; cancelled, replaced and no-show drivers do not count.
dv1.def_parcels: All parcels on the manifest. Under the number: how many were delivered, failed, returned and are still pending (waiting for hand-over or on the vehicle). Cancelled parcels are not part of the breakdown.
dv1.def_success: Delivered parcels ÷ (delivered + failed + returned). Only parcels with a final outcome count; pending and cancelled parcels do not. Shows — until the first outcome, never 0 %.
dv1.hint_no_outcomes: No parcel has a final outcome yet
dv1.def_first_attempt: Delivered parcels that needed at most one visit to the door ÷ all delivered parcels.
dv1.def_start: How far the first driver's arrival was from the scheduled start (negative = early). A driver is late when they arrive more than the grace period after the start. Shows — until a driver has arrived.
dv1.def_first_offer: From publishing the order until the first offer reached a driver.
dv1.def_fill: From publishing until the last slot was filled. Shows — while slots are still open.
dv1.def_execution: From the start of work (first route approved, or the hand-over for count-based jobs) until the order was completed or cancelled. It keeps running while the order is live.
dv1.def_price: What the business pays: the unit price locked at publishing × the billable parcels or days.
dv1.def_provider: What the driver side is paid for the same units at the locked rate.
dv1.def_margin: Customer price − provider cost, before VAT.
dv1.def_cod_due: Cash the recipients owe on this order's parcels that are not cancelled.
dv1.def_cod_collected: Cash the drivers collected from recipients at delivery.
dv1.def_cod_outstanding: Collected by the drivers minus what the warehouse or operations recorded as received back. It is the warehouse's money, handed over in person.
dv1.def_rating: Average stars the business gave the drivers of this order, over the ratings given so far.
dv1.def_support: Support cases that are not resolved plus complaints that are open or in progress, linked to this order.
dv1.milestones_sub: Each step of the order's life and the time since the one before it.
dv1.milestones_total: {time} from creation to the latest milestone
dv1.alerts_clear: Nothing on this order needs attention right now.
dv1.alert_unfilled: {n} driver slot(s) are still open and the order starts in {min} min.
dv1.alert_driver_late: {n} driver(s) not on site yet, {min} min after the start (grace period included).
dv1.alert_no_coords: {n} parcel(s) have no map location, so they cannot be shown on the map or planned reliably.
dv1.alert_unassigned: {n} parcel(s) are not assigned to any driver.
dv1.alert_returns_pending: {n} parcel(s) were not delivered and still have to be received back by the warehouse.
dv1.alert_cod_outstanding: Cash on delivery outstanding: {amount} collected by drivers and not yet handed back.
dv1.alert_support_open: {n} open support item(s) are linked to this order.
dv1.funnel_sub: What happened to every offer sent for this order (share of all offers).
dv1.mix_sub: Where every parcel of the order stands now.
dv1.reasons_sub: Failed, returned and missing parcels by the reason recorded.
dv1.delivery_sub: Time from hand-over to the driver until the parcel was delivered.
dv1.map_sub: The pickup pin and {n} parcel location(s).
dv1.map_sub_unlocated: {n} parcel location(s) shown; {m} parcel(s) have no map location.
dv1.map_empty: Nothing to show on the map
dv1.map_empty_hint: Parcels appear here once they have a map location.
dv1.idle_sub: Offers that are still waiting, were declined or expired.
dv1.f_no_pin: The warehouse pin is not set
dv1.gps_thinned: thinned so the map stays readable
dv1.gps_audited: opening this is recorded in the audit log
dv1.gps_none: No GPS positions were recorded for this job.
dv1.gps_hidden: The driver's GPS path needs the permission to view sensitive driver data.
dv1.parcels_search_ph: Code, order ref, recipient, phone or address
dv1.money_denied_hint: Prices, settlements and ledger entries need the permission to view finance.
dv1.price_sub: The price is locked when the order is published; later pricing changes do not affect it.
dv1.p_units: Slots × units per slot → billable units
dv1.p_rule_gone: The pricing rule can no longer be found; the locked snapshot above is what applies.
dv1.reserve_sub: Funds held from the business's wallet when the order was published, and what happened to them.
dv1.settle_sub: One settlement per driver offer: what the business is charged, what the provider is paid and the margin.
dv1.settle_none_hint: Settlements are created when a driver's work on the order is confirmed.
dv1.cod_sub: Per driver: what recipients owed, what was collected, what the warehouse received back and what is still with the driver.
dv1.cod_none: No cash on delivery on this order
dv1.cod_none_hint: Parcels with cash to collect appear here.
dv1.adjust_sub: Refunds and manual adjustments posted to wallets for this order.
dv1.ledger_sub: {n} entries reference this order, newest first.
dv1.ledger_none: No wallet entry references this order yet
dv1.chat_sub: {n} message(s) between the drivers and the business. Read-only.
dv1.chat_none_hint: Drivers and the business can chat once a driver has accepted.
dv1.sent_sub: SMS and webhooks the platform sent about this order. Recipients are masked and message texts are never stored.
dv1.sent_none_hint: Delivery codes, tracking links and webhook events appear here.
dv1.notif_sub: {n} notification(s) were created for this order.
dv1.search_sub: Search every parcel on the platform. Each result opens the full parcel view.

dv1.search_none_hint: Check the code or phone number, or search by the recipient's name.

dv1.pk_handover_hint: Loaded onto the vehicle → delivered or failed
dv1.pk_pin_far: More than {n} m: flagged for audit

dv1.evidence_sub: {n} item(s): proof photo, signature and photos from postponed or failed stops.

dv1.loc_no_pin: This parcel has no map location, so a delivery cannot be compared with a pin.

dv1.otp_no_messages: No messages recorded for this parcel.
dv1.pcod_offer_scope: for all of this driver's parcels on the order

dv2.docs_status_sub: The newest file of each type and when it expires.

dv2.ch_response_sub: Time from an offer being sent to the driver accepting it.

dv2.parcels_none_hint: Parcels appear here once the driver loads them.
dv2.loc_never: No position has been shared yet

dv2.sec_messages_sub: Codes and notices sent to this account (text is never stored).

dv2.hist_none_hint: Invitations and links appear here as they happen.

dv2.agreements_sub: All {n} versions, newest first. Sending a new one replaces a pending agreement.
dv2.def_drv_jobs: Jobs the driver finished in the period. A job is an accepted offer that reached the completed status; it counts on the day it was completed.
dv2.def_drv_parcels: Parcels the driver delivered in the period, counted on the delivery time.
dv2.def_drv_success: Share of the parcels resolved in the period that were delivered.
dv2.def_drv_success_d: Parcels delivered, failed or returned in the period (each counts once, when it was resolved)
dv2.def_drv_first_attempt: Share of delivered parcels that needed no second attempt.
dv2.def_drv_first_attempt_n: Parcels delivered with at most one attempt
dv2.def_drv_on_time: Share of jobs whose start time has passed where the driver arrived by the start time plus the grace period. A no-show counts as late.
dv2.def_drv_on_time_n: Jobs where the driver arrived in time
dv2.def_drv_on_time_d: Accepted jobs whose start time (plus grace) has passed, including no-shows
dv2.def_drv_acceptance: Share of offers sent to the driver that the driver accepted. Offers still waiting for an answer and applications by the driver are not counted.
dv2.def_drv_acceptance_d: Offers sent in the period that were accepted, declined or expired
dv2.def_drv_cancels: Jobs the driver cancelled plus jobs where the driver did not show up, counted on the day it was recorded.
dv2.def_drv_rating: Average of the stars the driver received in the period.
dv2.def_drv_rating_d: Number of ratings received in the period
dv2.def_drv_response: Average time between an offer being sent to the driver and the driver accepting it (offers sent by the system only).
dv2.def_drv_response_n: Total waiting time of the accepted offers
dv2.def_drv_response_d: Offers accepted in the period (sent by the system)
dv2.def_drv_online: Time the driver was available for work in the period, from the availability log. No data when the availability was never recorded.
dv2.def_drv_utilisation: How much of the time the driver was available they spent on jobs.
dv2.def_drv_utilisation_n: Time on jobs, from arrival to delivery or completion
dv2.def_drv_utilisation_d: Time online plus any time on a job outside online time
dv2.def_drv_earnings: What the driver's settlements created in the period pay out, before any withdrawal. Rejected settlements are excluded. For office drivers the money goes to the office.
dv2.def_drv_earnings_life: All settlements ever created for the driver, rejected ones excluded.
dv2.def_drv_cash_held: Cash on delivery the driver collected and has not yet handed over, right now.
dv2.def_ofc_drivers: Drivers currently linked to the office. Available = online, verified and not suspended.
dv2.def_ofc_active_drivers: Drivers who accepted at least one job for the office in the period.
dv2.def_ofc_new_drivers: Drivers who joined the office in the period (accepted its invitation or were linked by staff).
dv2.def_ofc_jobs: Jobs completed by the office's drivers through the office, counted on the completion day.
dv2.def_ofc_parcels: Parcels delivered by the office's drivers on jobs sent through the office.
dv2.def_ofc_success: Share of the parcels resolved in the period that were delivered, on jobs sent through the office.
dv2.def_ofc_success_d: Parcels delivered, failed or returned in the period (each counts once, when it was resolved)
dv2.def_ofc_on_time: Share of the office's jobs whose start time has passed where the driver arrived by the start time plus the grace period. A no-show counts as late.
dv2.def_ofc_on_time_n: Jobs where the driver arrived in time
dv2.def_ofc_on_time_d: Accepted jobs whose start time (plus grace) has passed, including no-shows
dv2.def_ofc_rating: Average of the stars received on jobs sent through the office in the period.
dv2.def_ofc_rating_d: Number of ratings received in the period
dv2.def_ofc_utilisation: How much of the time its drivers were available they spent on the office's jobs, over drivers whose availability is recorded.
dv2.def_ofc_utilisation_n: Time on jobs, from arrival to delivery or completion
dv2.def_ofc_utilisation_d: Time online plus any time on a job outside online time
dv2.def_ofc_earnings: What the office's settlements created in the period pay out. Rejected settlements are excluded.
dv2.def_ofc_paid: Settlements of the office that were paid in the period, counted on the payment day.

fr.note_pop_drivers: Drivers: every driver account the filters allow. A driver is listed in the performance table when they had an offer, a job, a parcel, a rating or online time in the period.
fr.note_pop_offices: Courier offices: every office account the filters allow, plus one row for independent drivers (drivers who belong to no office).
fr.note_pop_independent: The Independent drivers row adds up the drivers who belong to no office, for comparison.
fr.note_pop_selected: Offices were selected, so independent drivers are not included.
fr.note_pop_attribution: A driver's work counts for the office the driver is linked to now. Settlement figures (earnings, payouts) are the ones paid to the office.
fr.note_pop_office_work: Only work done through an office is counted here; independent drivers are in the Drivers report.
fr.note_anchor_offers: Offers count on the day they were sent; jobs on the day the driver accepted them.
fr.note_anchor_jobs: Warehouse and job times use the jobs accepted in the period (kept jobs only: not cancelled, declined or replaced).
fr.note_anchor_punctuality: Punctuality counts on the job's start day: on time = arrived by the start time; late = arrived after it within the late-grace setting; very late = arrived after start plus grace.
fr.note_anchor_punctuality_g: Punctuality counts on the job's start day: on time = arrived by the start time; late = arrived up to {grace} minutes after it; very late = arrived more than {grace} minutes after it.
fr.note_anchor_parcels: Parcels count on the day they were resolved: delivery time for delivered, failure time for failed or returned. A parcel counts once.
fr.note_anchor_online: Online time is the time the driver was marked available; online days are the Riyadh days with some available time.
fr.note_daily: Daily tables have a row for every Riyadh day (up to {max} days). A day is not a cohort: each measure counts on its own date, so a day's offers, jobs and parcels need not belong to each other.
fr.note_averages: Averages use only the rows that have both timestamps; a step shorter than zero or longer than {hours} hours ({stop} hours at the door) is left out as an error. Where there is nothing to average the table shows a dash, never zero.
fr.note_lateness: Average lateness and arrival-versus-start count at most {hours} hours early or late per job, so one request whose start time was never moved cannot swamp the average.
fr.note_radius: Radius distance is the straight line from the order's pickup pin to the delivered parcel's pin (where it was delivered, or its address pin), added up over delivered parcels that have both pins. It is not the road distance.
fr.note_route: Route distance is the planned driving distance of the delivered legs. It exists only for routes planned with Google Maps; a dash means no planned route.
fr.note_gps: GPS distance adds up the movement between consecutive location fixes (gaps over {gap} minutes, jumps over {jump} km and fixes less accurate than {accuracy} m are dropped). It is computed only when the selection is narrowed to {drivers} drivers or fewer, and fixes are kept for 90 days.
fr.note_complaints: Complaints are those filed by others (not by the driver) about the driver's jobs, counted on the filing date.
fr.note_failures: Failure reasons count failed and returned parcels by the reason the driver gave at the door.
fr.note_money: Money: settlements count on the day they were created (paid out on the day they were paid); rejected settlements are left out. Amounts are in SAR; the customer price excludes VAT.
fr.note_cod: Cash on delivery counts on the day it was collected or handed in. Held cash is a balance as of now: all cash collected minus all cash handed in, per driver, never below zero.
fr.note_gap_warehouse: Warehouse times (check-in, loading, wait) exist only when the warehouse records attendance and loading; otherwise they show a dash.
fr.note_gap_route: Route distance needs a route planned with Google Maps; without one it shows a dash.
fr.note_gap_gps: GPS distance depends on the driver's phone sending locations; stretches without fixes are not counted.
fr.note_gap_fines: Penalties are counted (cancellations, suspensions) but fines have no amounts on this platform.
fr.note_gap_promise: Jobs have a start time but no promised delivery time per order, so lateness measures the arrival at the warehouse, not the delivery.
