fdr.period_note: The period columns show {from} – {to} ({days} days). Lifetime columns always cover everything.
fdr.amounts_note: Amounts in the table are in Saudi riyals (SAR).
fdr.period_note_all: The period columns cover all time, so they equal the lifetime columns.
fdr.via_office_note: This driver is paid through {office}: earnings go to the office wallet, so the driver has no wallet balance of his own.
fdr.paid_to_office_hint: Includes pay that went to his office
fdr.empty_statement: No money moved in this period. Choose a longer period to see more.
fdr.empty_ledger: No wallet entries in this period (drivers paid through an office have no wallet).
fdr.empty_withdrawals: No withdrawal requests in this period.
fdr.empty_cash: No cash was collected or handed over in this period.
fdr.note_money: Money is in Saudi riyals (SAR) with two decimals. Counts are whole numbers. Dates are on the Riyadh clock.
fdr.note_wallet: Wallet columns are empty for a driver who belongs to an office ("Paid via office"): his earnings are paid into the office wallet, not into his own.
fdr.note_earned: Gross earnings = the provider amount of every settlement that is not rejected. Paid = settlements paid out; Pending payout = settlements waiting to be paid (pending review, approved, in a batch); Payout failed = payouts that failed and will be retried.
fdr.note_cash: Cash held = cash collected from recipients minus cash handed over to the warehouse or operations (never below zero). The platform only tracks it; it never passes through the wallet.
fdr.note_period: Period columns count each measure on its own date: earnings by settlement creation, payouts by payment date, jobs by acceptance, parcels by delivery, cash by collection / hand-over. The figures equal Reports › Drivers › Money for the same period.
fdr.note_penalties: Penalties = manual wallet debits made by staff (adjustments below zero). Strike suspensions carry no amount on this platform.
fdr.note_statement: The statement is a journal, not a sum: a settlement shows what a job earned, and its payout appears later as a wallet row. Only wallet rows carry the running wallet balance (after that entry). Withdrawals are the wallet rows requested / paid / returned.
fdr.note_cash_rows: Cash rows (collected / handed over) show cash the driver took in and gave back, one row per order and day for collection. They do not change the wallet. In = cash collected; Out = cash handed over.
fdr.note_ledger: Wallet ledger: Credit and Debit are the change of the available balance; the balance column is the available balance after the entry.
fdr.note_cash_tab: Cash on delivery: Collected and Handed over count only what happened inside the period; Outstanding now is what the driver still holds for that order today.
cdc.all_sub: Every order where a driver collected cash, and who holds what. Amounts in SAR.

lp.off_lead: SMS can be off on purpose (the system is put into service without it) or because the keys are missing. The effect is the same.

lp.off_2: The delivery code is not asked for: the driver confirms by scanning the parcel code, plus the recipient's signature where the warehouse requires it.
lp.off_3: Sign-in is unaffected: everyone keeps using username and password.
lp.off_4: Parcels already on the road are not blocked: drivers simply stop being asked for a code.

lp.on_2: The driver asks for the code at the door, as set for each warehouse.

sys.pv_demo_on: On: demo accounts are offered on the sign-in page and money is simulated.
sys.pv_demo_off: Off: this is a live site.
sys.unlock_sms: Tracking links and delivery codes for recipients; welcome messages.
sys.unlock_bank: Wallet top-up by transfer, approved by Finance.
sys.unlock_maps: Best stop order and distances for drivers.
sys.unlock_demo: Demo accounts and simulated money — never for real customers.
sys.sch_lead: Runs the housekeeping every minute: expiry, retries, settlements.
sys.sch_errors: Steps that failed in the last run
sys.q_lead: Work waiting for the system or for a person.
sys.rt_lead: What is running and where. No secrets are shown.
sys.banner_hint: From the system-status page. The most serious are listed first.
sys.w.scheduler_never: The scheduler has not run yet: offers do not expire and nothing is retried or paid out. Start the internal scheduler or call the cron address every minute.
sys.w.scheduler_stale: The scheduler has not run for {minutes} minutes: expiry, retries and payouts are on hold.
sys.w.scheduler_errors: The last scheduler run had {n} failed steps; they are retried on the next run.
sys.w.scheduler_external: The scheduler does not run inside the app: make sure an external cron calls the tick every minute.
sys.w.sms_off: SMS is off: delivery codes are bypassed and no text is sent.
sys.w.sms_not_configured: SMS is switched on but its keys are incomplete: no text is sent and delivery codes are bypassed.
sys.w.sms_demo: SMS is simulated (demo mode): nothing is really sent.
sys.w.sms_balance_low: The SMS balance is low: {balance} points left.
sys.w.no_funding_method: Companies cannot add funds: neither card payments nor bank transfer is available.
sys.w.paytabs_not_configured: Card payments are switched on but the PayTabs keys are incomplete: the card option is hidden.
sys.w.bank_not_configured: Bank transfer is switched on but the bank details are incomplete: the option is hidden.
sys.w.storage_missing: No file storage is configured: document uploads are refused.
sys.w.storage_local_prod: Files are stored on the server's local disk: they are lost if the server is rebuilt. Use S3-compatible storage.
sys.w.maps_no_key: Route planning is on but there is no Google Maps key: stops are ordered with a straight-line estimate.
sys.w.maps_key_idle: A Google Maps key is set but route planning is off, so it is not used.
sys.w.demo_mode: Demo mode is on: demo accounts and the super admin's sign-in details are shown on the sign-in page. Never use it for real customers.
sys.w.webhooks_dead: {n} webhook deliveries were given up after repeated failures.
sys.w.partner_overdue: {n} updates to warehouse systems are overdue.
sys.w.partner_dead: {n} updates to warehouse systems were given up.
sys.w.withdrawals_waiting: {n} withdrawal requests have waited more than {hours} hours.
sys.w.tickets_unanswered: {n} support tickets have had no reply for more than {hours} hours.
sys.w.migrations_pending: {n} database updates are not applied yet: restart the app or run the migration.
sys.w.db_slow: The database is slow to answer ({ms} ms).
sys.w.env_auth_secret_short: AUTH_SECRET is shorter than 16 characters: delivery codes cannot be signed safely.
sys.w.env_auth_secret_missing: AUTH_SECRET is not set: delivery codes cannot be signed.
sys.w.env_auth_secret_placeholder: AUTH_SECRET is a placeholder value: anybody could forge delivery codes.
sys.w.env_cron_secret_weak: CRON_SECRET is a placeholder or too short: anybody could run the housekeeping.
sys.w.env_cron_secret_missing_internal: CRON_SECRET is not set: the operator health view and the cron address are unavailable (the internal scheduler still runs).
sys.w.env_cron_secret_missing: CRON_SECRET is not set and the internal scheduler is off: nothing runs the housekeeping.
sys.w.env_storage_unsupported: STORAGE_DRIVER has a value that is not supported (use s3 or local).
sys.w.env_storage_s3_incomplete: STORAGE_DRIVER is s3 but these are not set: {missing}.
sys.w.env_storage_local_no_dir: Local storage without UPLOAD_DIR: files go inside the app folder and are lost when the app is rebuilt.
sys.w.env_integrations_secret_missing: INTEGRATIONS_SECRET is not set: warehouse-system connections cannot be saved, and keys entered in the console fall back to AUTH_SECRET.
sys.w.env_demo_ignored: DEMO_MODE=true is ignored on a live site because the acknowledgement variable is missing.
sys.w.env_private_outbound: ALLOW_PRIVATE_OUTBOUND is set: outbound calls may reach private addresses (for tests only).
sys.w.env_app_url_local: APP_URL is missing or points to localhost: tracking links in messages and notifications will be wrong.
sys.w.env_trusted_proxy: TRUSTED_PROXY is not understood: every caller shares one rate-limit bucket.
sys.w.env_db_pool_max: DB_POOL_MAX is not a positive number: the default is used.
sys.w.env_msegat_url_insecure: MSEGAT_API_URL is not https: the SMS key would travel unencrypted.
sys.w.env_paytabs_url_insecure: PAYTABS_BASE_URL is not https: the payment key would travel unencrypted.
pay.method_title: How do you want to add funds?
pay.method_card_hint: Debit or credit card on PayTabs' secure payment page. Your wallet is credited as soon as the payment is confirmed.
pay.method_bank_hint: Transfer to our bank account and upload the receipt. Finance credits your wallet after checking it.
pay.card_note: You will be taken to PayTabs' secure page to enter your card. JR Logistics never sees or stores your card number.
pay.card_redirecting: Taking you to the payment page…
pay.none_title: Adding funds is arranged through support
pay.none_body: Online top-up is not switched on yet. Contact us and we will add funds to your wallet.
pay.contact_none: Support contact details are not set yet — open a support ticket instead.
pay.bank_unavailable: Bank transfer is not available right now.
pay.bank_code: Your reference (write it in the transfer description)
pay.bank_code_hint: Finance matches the money to your company with this reference.
pay.f_date_invalid: Pick the date of the transfer (not a future date)
pay.f_ref: Bank reference number of the transfer
pay.f_ref_hint: The reference your bank shows for this transfer (not the IBAN).
pay.f_ref_invalid: Enter the bank's reference number (at least 4 characters)
pay.f_payer: Name of the account holder who paid (optional)
pay.f_receipt_hint: Photo or PDF of the receipt: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 8 MB.
pay.f_receipt_type: Only JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF files are accepted
pay.f_receipt_size: The file is larger than 8 MB
pay.f_sent: Request sent. Finance will check it and credit your wallet.
pay.f_dup_title: This looks like a request you already sent
pay.f_dup_body: A request with the same bank reference and amount already exists. Send again only if this is a different transfer.
pay.hist_sub: Card payments and bank transfers you started
pay.cancel_confirm: Cancel the bank-transfer request of {amount}? You can send a new one later.
pay.ret_paid: Payment received: {amount} was added to your wallet.
pay.ret_pending: We are confirming your payment with PayTabs. This usually takes a few seconds; your wallet is credited as soon as it is confirmed.
pay.ret_failed: The payment was not completed. Nothing was charged to your card. You can try again.
pay.ret_review: Your payment needs a manual check by Finance. We will notify you as soon as it is settled.
pay.q_sub: Check each bank transfer against the bank statement, then approve or reject it. Card payments are credited automatically; they are listed here for reconciliation.
pay.q_empty_hint: New bank-transfer requests from companies appear here.
pay.ap_check: Approve only after the money is in the bank account and matches the receipt. The wallet is credited at once.
pay.ap_received_hint: Change it only if the bank received a different amount.
pay.dup_flag: Same reference and amount as {n} other request(s)
pay.dup_warn: Another request quotes the same bank reference and amount ({n}). Check the bank statement before approving so one transfer is not credited twice.
pay.c_empty_hint: Card payments started by companies appear here.
pay.c_review_note: {n} card payment(s) need a person: PayTabs confirmed them but something does not match what was expected. The company has not been credited.
pay.review_cart_mismatch: PayTabs confirmed a payment for a different order
pay.review_amount_mismatch: The amount PayTabs charged differs from the amount requested
pay.review_on_hold_too_long: On hold at PayTabs for more than 2 days
pay.wd_select_all: Select all waiting on this page
pay.wd_export_done: Bank file downloaded. It contains full IBANs: keep it safe.
pay.wd_mp_total: {n} withdrawals, {amount} in total. Make the bank transfers first, then confirm here.
pay.wd_mp_hint: The batch or transfer reference from your bank. It is saved on every selected withdrawal.
pay.s_sub: Card payments through PayTabs, bank transfers and the top-up amounts.
pay.s_off_body: Both methods can be switched off. While none is available, companies are told to contact support, and Finance adds funds with a wallet adjustment.
pay.s_demo_note: Demo mode is on: while no real method is ready, the simulated top-up stays available to companies. As soon as a method is ready it replaces the simulated one.
pay.s_super_only: Only the super admin can change payment settings.
pay.s_card_lead: Companies pay on PayTabs' secure page. The wallet is credited only after PayTabs confirms the payment to our server.
pay.s_not_configured: The switch is on, but the profile ID or the server key is missing: cards are not offered yet.
pay.s_region_hint: The region of your PayTabs account. A wrong region gives authentication errors.
pay.s_profile_hint: A number shown in the PayTabs dashboard (test and live profiles differ).
pay.s_profile_invalid: The profile ID is a number
pay.s_key_hint: Developers > Key management in the PayTabs dashboard. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
pay.s_key_invalid: Paste the server key exactly as PayTabs shows it
pay.s_key_remove_body: Remove the saved server key? Card payments stop until a new key is saved.
pay.s_test_ok: PayTabs accepted the region, profile ID and server key.
pay.s_test_save_first: Save your changes first; the test uses the saved values.
pay.test_auth: PayTabs rejected the credentials. Check the region, the profile ID and the server key.
pay.test_rate_limit: PayTabs asked us to slow down. Try again in a minute.
pay.test_unavailable: PayTabs could not be reached. Try again later.
pay.test_bad_request: PayTabs refused the test request. Check the profile ID.
pay.test_not_configured: Enter the profile ID and the server key first.
pay.s_urls_hint: JR Logistics sends both addresses with every payment, so nothing has to be registered. To also receive PayTabs notifications for every transaction, add the callback address in the PayTabs dashboard under Developers > Payment Notification > Configuration.
pay.s_https_warn: The app address (APP_URL) is not HTTPS. PayTabs sends payment details only to HTTPS addresses, so card payments cannot be confirmed until it is.
pay.s_base_override: A test PayTabs address is set on the server (PAYTABS_BASE_URL); the region above is not used.
pay.s_bank_lead: Companies transfer to this account and upload the receipt; Finance checks it and credits the wallet.
pay.s_bank_incomplete: The switch is on, but the bank name, account holder or IBAN is missing: transfers are not offered yet.
pay.s_iban_invalid: This is not a valid Saudi IBAN (24 characters, starts with SA)
pay.s_swift_invalid: A SWIFT / BIC code has 8 or 11 characters
pay.s_note_hint: For example the working hours of Finance, or how to write the reference.
pay.s_limits_lead: The smallest and the largest single top-up, for cards and bank transfers.
pay.s_limits_order: The smallest amount cannot be above the largest
pay.s_limits_preview: Companies can add between {min} and {max} at a time.
notif.topup_paid: Your card payment was received: SAR {amount} was added to your wallet.
notif.topup_failed: Your card payment of SAR {amount} was not completed. Nothing was charged.
notif.topup_approved: Finance approved your bank transfer: SAR {amount} was added to your wallet.
notif.topup_rejected: Your bank-transfer top-up of SAR {amount} was rejected: {reason}
notif.topup_requested: {name} sent a bank-transfer top-up of SAR {amount} for approval.
notif.topup_review: A card payment of SAR {amount} was confirmed by PayTabs but does not match what was expected. Please check it.
lg.module_business_sub: For companies that send goods and parcels.
lg.module_office_sub: For courier offices that run their own drivers.
lg.module_driver_sub: For drivers who take delivery jobs.
lg.module_privacy_sub: What personal data we collect, why, and your rights.
lg.index_sub: The rules for each kind of account, and how we handle personal data. Choose the one that applies to you.
lg.builtin_notice: This text is a draft pending legal review. The platform operator has not yet reviewed and published its own version.
lg.reg_accept: I have read and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
lg.reg_failed: The text could not be loaded. Open it on its own page.
lg.reg_scroll_hint: Scroll to read the whole text.
lg.gate_sub: Please read the new version and accept it to carry on using the platform.
lg.gate_stale: A newer version was published while you were reading. Please read it.
lg.gate_failed: We could not record your acceptance. Please try again.
lg.ad_title: Terms of use and privacy policy
lg.ad_sub: The texts people accept when they register, and the privacy policy. Every document has a version in Arabic, English and Urdu, and every change is a new published version.
lg.ad_review_title: Have a lawyer review the built-in texts
lg.ad_review_body: The built-in texts are drafts written in plain language for the platform as it works today. They have not been reviewed by a lawyer and are not legal advice. Have your lawyer review them, change what is needed, and publish the result here as a version. Fill in the company identity in Settings › Company so that the texts name the right company.
lg.ad_src_legacy: Old free text from the settings
lg.ad_readonly: You can read these texts but not change them: changing them needs the permission to edit settings.
lg.ed_format_hint: Formatting: “## Heading”, “- list item”, “1. numbered item”, “**bold**”, “[link text](https://…)”. HTML is not allowed. The placeholders below are filled in from the company settings when the text is shown.
lg.ed_unknown_ph: Unknown placeholders (they will show as typed): {names}
lg.ed_discard_confirm: Discard the saved draft of this language? The text in force is not affected.
lg.ed_restore_confirm: Replace the editor and the saved draft with the built-in text? Nothing is published until you publish.
lg.ed_restored: Built-in text restored as a draft
lg.ed_legacy_title: An old free text is in force
lg.ed_legacy_body: The text typed in the old settings page is shown (version {v}) until you publish a version here. It has no languages: every language shows it.
lg.pub_sub: All three languages are published together. A language without a draft keeps the text in force.
lg.pub_no_drafts: No draft is saved. Save a draft in at least one language first (the first publication may use the built-in text as it is).
lg.pub_version_hint: For example 1.1. It must be new for this document.
lg.pub_effective_hint: Riyadh time. Leave empty to apply it now; a later date announces it in advance.
lg.pub_require_hint: The people this document is for are stopped at their next visit until they accept the new version. Use it for material changes.
lg.pub_note: What changed (shown to the people who must accept)
lg.pub_confirm: Publish version {v} of “{doc}” in all three languages? Published versions cannot be edited; a change is a new version.
lg.pub_confirm_require: Everyone this document is for will be asked to accept it again.
lg.pub_nochange: Nothing has changed since the published version. Save a draft with your changes first.
lg.pub_version_taken: That version label is already used for this document. Choose another.
lg.pub_version_bad: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores (at most 20).
lg.hist_empty: Nothing has been published yet. The built-in text (version {v}) is in force.
lg.stat_note: Counts people, not clicks. Accounts created by staff accept when they first publish a request or take a job.
pv.card_sub: See what we keep about you, download a copy, or ask us to erase your account.
pv.export_body: One file (JSON) with your profile, orders or jobs, wallet and payments, support messages, notifications and sign-in history. It never contains passwords or other people's details.
pv.delete_body: Deleting is permanent. We remove your name, phone, e-mail, username, documents, messages and notifications. Invoices, payments and past orders stay in our books without your identity, because the law requires us to keep them. Our team reviews every request.
pv.delete_blocked_body: Settle these first, then ask again:
pv.confirm_body: When our team approves it, your account is erased for good and you can no longer sign in. You can withdraw the request until then.
pv.req_open_title: Your deletion request is with our team
pv.req_open_body: Sent {time}. The decision will appear here.
pv.retention_body: How long we keep things: read notifications {days} days · recipient details of finished parcels {months} months (0 = kept) · documents of closed accounts {years} years (0 = kept).
pv.blocker_role_not_supported: Staff accounts are not erased here.
pv.blocker_already_anonymised: This account has already been erased.
pv.blocker_open_requests: {n} open order(s): finish or cancel them.
pv.blocker_returns_pending: {n} undelivered parcel(s) still to be returned to your warehouse.
pv.blocker_open_jobs: {n} job(s) in progress: complete them first.
pv.blocker_open_office_jobs: {n} job(s) of your drivers are in progress.
pv.blocker_linked_drivers: {n} driver(s) are still linked to your office: unlink them first.
pv.blocker_wallet_funds: {amount} in your wallet (available, reserved or on hold): withdraw it or ask support.
pv.blocker_wallet_debt: You owe {amount} (credit in use): settle it first.
pv.blocker_pending_withdrawals: {n} withdrawal(s) still waiting to be paid.
pv.blocker_outstanding_cash: {amount} of cash on delivery not handed over yet ({n} order(s)).
pv.blocker_cash_with_drivers: {amount} of your cash on delivery is still with drivers ({n} order(s)).
pv.admin_sub: Decide account-erasure requests and export what the platform holds about one person.
pv.none_waiting_hint: New requests from companies, courier offices and drivers appear here.
pv.checklist_ok: Nothing blocks it: no open work, no money, no cash, no pending payments.
pv.checklist_blocked: Blocked. The request can be approved only after these are cleared:
pv.pre_staffNotes: Staff notes about the person deleted
pv.what_goes: Removed: name, phone, e-mail, username, password, IBAN, national ID, plate, documents, notifications, sign-in history, locations and the person's own free texts.
pv.what_stays: Stays, without identity: wallet and ledger, settlements, invoices, orders and parcels (without recipients), the audit trail.
pv.sure: I understand that erasing {name} is permanent and cannot be undone.
pv.reject_hint: Say plainly why the account cannot be erased now.
pv.summary_done: Erased: {n} records changed; {files} stored file(s) still to be removed.
pv.lookup_hint: Find a person to export everything held about them, or to file an erasure request for someone who asked by e-mail or phone.
pv.staff_export_note: The export contains personal information: hand it only to the person it belongs to.
pv.ret_hint: How long the platform keeps personal data before it removes it. A scheduled job applies these periods every hour.
pv.ret_notifications_hint: Unread ones are kept at least 12 months.
pv.ret_recipients_hint: Name, phone, address and notes are blanked; code, status and proof stay. 0 = keep.
pv.ret_documents_hint: Suspended accounts silent for this long, and erased accounts. 0 = keep.
pv.ret_note: Also applied: delivered webhook deliveries are removed after 90 days and dead letters after 180; location points after 90 days; sign-in events after 400 days.
co.sub: Who the platform is. Printed on invoices and shown on the sign-in page, the tracking page and the public footer.
co.legal_hint: The registered name as it appears on the commercial registration.
co.invoice_note: Invoices show the legal name, VAT number, commercial registration and address as the seller. Fill them in before issuing real invoices.
co.support_hint: Shown as tappable links on the sign-in page, the tracking page and the footer. Leave a channel empty to hide it.
co.privacy_hint: Where people send questions and requests about their personal data. Shown in the privacy policy and on the Privacy & data card.
co.preview_hint: How the help block and the footer line look to visitors.
co.preview_empty: No support channel yet: visitors will see no help block.
co.err_vatNumber: A VAT number has 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
co.err_crNumber: A commercial registration number has 10 digits.
co.err_website: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://
notif.privacy_request_new: {name} asked to have their account erased.
notif.privacy_request_received: We received your account-erasure request. Our team will review it; the decision will appear in your profile.
err.ERASURE_BLOCKED: This account cannot be erased yet: settle what is open first.
cr.banner_warn_title: You are close to your cash limit
cr.banner_warn: You hold {amount} in cash — {pct}% of your {limit} limit. Hand it over to the warehouse soon so new jobs keep coming.

cr.banner_over_limit_block_title: New jobs are paused — cash limit reached

cr.banner_overdue: {overdue} of your cash has been with you for more than {maxDays} days (the oldest for {days} days). Please hand it over to the warehouse.
cr.banner_overdue_block_title: New jobs are paused — cash overdue
cr.banner_overdue_block: {overdue} of your cash has been with you for more than {maxDays} days (the oldest for {days} days), so new offers are paused. Hand it over to the warehouse and offers return as soon as it is recorded. Jobs you already accepted keep running.
cr.banner_lien: {lien} of your wallet balance is held back and cannot be withdrawn until the overdue cash is handed over.
cr.todo_1: Take the cash to the warehouse of each order listed in “Cash with me”.
cr.todo_2: The warehouse records “Receive money” — everything returns to normal the moment it is recorded.
cr.card_sub: The platform limits how much cash a driver may hold and for how long, to protect the warehouses' money.
cr.card_age_none: No cash with you right now
cr.card_age_rule: Cash that stays with you for more than {maxDays} days counts as overdue.
cr.paused_limit: You reached your cash limit. Hand the cash over to the warehouse and offers return as soon as it is recorded.
cr.paused_overdue: Some of your cash is overdue. Hand it over to the warehouse and offers return as soon as it is recorded.
notif.cash_limit_warning: You hold SAR {amount} in cash — {pct}% of your SAR {limit} limit. Hand it over to the warehouse to keep receiving jobs.
notif.cash_overdue: Overdue cash: SAR {amount} has been with you for {days} days (the maximum is {maxDays}). Hand it over to the warehouse now.
notif.cash_blocked: New jobs are paused: you hold SAR {amount} in cash, over your SAR {limit} limit. Hand it over to the warehouse to receive offers again.
notif.office_driver_cash: Your driver {driver} holds SAR {amount} in cash (the oldest for {days} days). Ask them to hand it over to the warehouse.
err.CASH_LIMIT: New jobs are paused while you hold too much cash or cash past its handover time. Give the cash to the warehouse and try again.
err.CASH_OUTSTANDING: Part of your balance is held until you hand over the cash that is past its handover time. Withdraw less, or hand the cash over first.
cr.aging_sub: How long the cash drivers hold has been with them, counted from the first collection on each order.
cr.office_sub: Cash on delivery your drivers collected and have not yet handed to the warehouses: per driver and per order.
cr.office_readonly: This page is read-only. The warehouse records the money it receives from a driver; your drivers' limits and handover time are set by the platform.
cr.office_at_risk: {n} driver(s) over the limit or overdue
cr.office_empty_hint: When your drivers deliver cash-on-delivery parcels, the cash they hold appears here.
cr.office_truncated: Showing the first 500 orders. Download the CSV for the full list.
cr.set_sub: Drivers collect cash on delivery and hand it to the warehouse later. These limits protect that money: a warning first, then no new offers until the cash is handed over.
cr.set_enabled_hint: On by default. Off: no limits, no notices and no blocks (the amounts are still shown).
cr.set_limit_hint: At or above this amount a driver gets no new offers. 0 = no money limit.
cr.set_warn_hint: The driver and his office are notified once a day.
cr.set_days_hint: Cash with a driver for longer than this is overdue. 0 = no age limit.
cr.set_block: Pause new offers when over the limit or overdue
cr.set_block_hint: Jobs already accepted keep running; offers return the moment the warehouse records the cash.
cr.set_lien: Hold back withdrawals for overdue cash
cr.set_lien_hint: A driver may withdraw at most his balance minus the cash that is past its handover time.
cr.set_off_note: Cash limits are off: drivers can hold any amount for any time and nobody is warned.
cr.set_invalid: Fix the highlighted values to save.
cr.ops_sub: When the operations queue raises an alert for a waiting item.
alert.cash_over_limit: Driver is over the cash limit
alert.route_stalled: Route started but nothing is happening
alert.dead_letters: Messages that could not be delivered
gp.set_offer_expiry_hint: A job offer nobody answered lapses after this long; the next housekeeping run offers the job again.
gp.set_unfilled_alert_hint: Operations see a warning for a published request that still has open slots this close to its start.
gp.set_max_topup_hint: No single top-up of a company wallet may exceed this amount, whatever way it is paid.
gp.k_stranded_hint: {n} office drivers hold money they cannot see or withdraw
gp.move_title: Move the balance to the office
gp.move_note: {amount} in the wallet of {driver} will be moved to the wallet of {office}, as two audited adjustments through the platform account. The driver and the office are notified.
gp.move_done: The balance was moved to the office.
gp.stranded_title: {amount} is stranded in this driver's own wallet
gp.stranded_body: He joined {office} with money in his wallet. He can no longer see or withdraw it, and {office} does not receive it. Move it to the office's wallet.
gp.invite_blocked_title: Empty your wallet before you join an office
gp.invite_blocked_body: You have {amount} in your wallet or a withdrawal waiting ({n}). Once you join, the office is paid and you can no longer see or withdraw it. Withdraw it first (or ask support to move it to the office), then accept.
err.WALLET_NOT_EMPTY: You still have money in your wallet or a withdrawal waiting. Withdraw it first (or ask support to move it to the office), then accept the invitation.
notif.balance_moved_to_office: Your remaining wallet balance of {amount} SAR was moved to your office {office}.
notif.driver_balance_received: The remaining wallet balance of {driver} ({amount} SAR) was moved to your office wallet.
notif.document_expiring: Your {docType} expires on {expiresOn} — {days} day(s) left. Upload the renewed document in time so your account is not interrupted.
notif.document_expiring__short: One of your documents expires soon. Upload the renewed one in time so your account is not interrupted.
gp.doc_attention_title: {n} document(s) expire soon or have expired
gp.doc_attention_hint: Upload the renewed document before the date. A driver whose required document has expired stops receiving offers until the new one is approved.
gp.rj_align_body: {n} member(s) hold a different list of permissions than this role ({count} permissions). Aligning gives each of them exactly the role's permissions.
gp.rj_align_note: Permissions they hold on top of the role are removed; permissions the role has and they lack are added. The change is written to the audit log.
gp.rj_aligned: Members now hold the role's permissions.
gp.rj_factory_title: The factory preset of this role has permissions it does not hold
gp.rj_factory_body: A release can add a permission to a preset, but a role that already exists is never changed by itself. Add them here, then save — the members follow the role.
dtk.act.role.align: Role members aligned with the role
gp.fo_sub: Every courier office: what it is owed, what its wallet holds, what was paid out, and what its drivers' own wallets still hold.
gp.fo_k_payable_hint: Settlements not paid yet (an open complaint holds one)
gp.fo_empty_hint: Offices appear here once they register.
gp.fo_note_money: Amounts are in Saudi riyals. Earnings are the settlements whose payee is the office; they are paid into the office wallet as soon as a driver's work ends.
gp.fo_note_payable: Payable = settlements still pending, approved or ready for a batch (for example held by an open complaint). Wallet = what the office holds now and may withdraw.
gp.fo_note_stranded: Stranded = what the wallets of the office's own drivers still hold: money the office did not receive and the drivers can no longer see or withdraw. Staff can move it to the office from Finance › Drivers.
gp.fo_note_period: The period columns follow the period you chose; the others always cover everything.
gp.land_sub_b2c: Stores and warehouses send each parcel to the person waiting for it, and every delivery is proved with a one-time code, a photo or a signature.
err.UPGRADE_REQUIRED: A new version of the app is required — please update it to continue.
notif.stop_marked_delivered: {ref}: operations marked parcel {code} as delivered for you
notif.stop_marked_failed: {ref}: operations marked parcel {code} as not delivered for you
notif.parcels_added: {ref}: {count} parcel(s) were added to your job — the warehouse will hand them over
notif.parcels_reassigned: {ref}: operations moved {count} parcel(s) to another driver of this order
notif.recipient_corrected: {ref}: recipient details of parcel {code} were corrected — check the stop
notif.request_rescheduled: {ref}: operations changed the start time or the pickup address of your order
notif.offer_rescheduled: {ref}: the time or pickup address of this job changed — check it before you accept
event.request_rescheduled: Start time or pickup address changed by operations
ot.proof_ops_long: Delivery was confirmed by operations on the driver's behalf (no delivery code)
ot.app_hint: The oldest app version that may still use the platform. Older apps are asked to update and cannot work until they do; leave empty for no minimum.
ot.app_min_hint: Like 1.2.0 or 1.2.0+45 (the number after + is the build). Empty = no minimum.
ot.app_url_bad: Use a link that starts with https://
ot.app_note: Saving takes effect within seconds. An app below the minimum sees an «Update required» screen with this store link; the website and integrations are never affected. Raise the minimum only after the new version is in the store.
ot.ov_hint: For a driver who cannot continue (dead phone, emergency): mark his open stops delivered or not delivered. The recipient's code, signature and arrival are skipped and this is recorded under your name.
ot.ov_none_open: Every stop is resolved. Finish the route to close the job and pay the driver.
ot.ov_bypass_delivered: The delivery code and signature are skipped. Only do this when you are sure the parcel reached the recipient (a call from the driver or the recipient).
ot.ov_bypass_failed: The parcel stays with the driver and comes back to the warehouse like any undelivered parcel; the company is told.
ot.ov_cash_hint: Cash on delivery: type the amount the recipient paid, in riyals. It must equal the amount due.
ot.ov_receiver: Name of the person who received it (optional)
ot.ov_reason: Why are you doing this for the driver?
ot.ov_reason_hint: Required. Kept in the audit trail.
ot.fin_title: Finish the route for the driver
ot.fin_hint: Reports the route as finished: the delivered count is the parcels marked delivered, the job is confirmed and the driver is paid as usual. Undelivered parcels come back to the warehouse.
ot.order_hint: Changes made for the company and the drivers. Each one needs a reason and is recorded.
ot.resched_note: Possible while no driver has accepted. The company and the drivers holding an offer are told.
ot.resched_pin_hint: If the address moved, give the new map pin; otherwise the old pin stays.
ot.reassign_title: Move parcels of an ended route
ot.reassign_note: The warehouse hands these parcels to the chosen driver with the normal loading step. The price of the moved parcels is reserved again from the company's wallet (the first driver was paid only for what he delivered).
ot.reassign_no_target: No other driver can take them yet: a driver who already left the warehouse cannot receive more parcels.
ot.rf_hint: Only while the parcel is on its way and the driver has not arrived at the address. A new phone number retires the old delivery code and, where delivery codes are used, the recipient is texted a new one. Fill in only what changes.
ot.wh_fail: Your server did not accept it: {error}. It will be retried automatically.
ot.api_more_note: More calls for your order system. Each needs a key with the matching scope (jobs:read for the quote, jobs:write to cancel or correct).
ot.api_openapi_note: every call, field and error, ready for Postman or a code generator
ot.bc_sub: Send an in-app message to a chosen group, in each person's language.
ot.bc_new_hint: Choose who gets it, write it in the languages you need, check the number of people, then send. It cannot be recalled.
ot.bc_roles_all: none ticked = companies, drivers and offices
ot.bc_office_hint: The office and the drivers linked to it
ot.bc_person_hint: Choose one person to send only to them (the other filters are then ignored).
ot.bc_too_many: Too many people — narrow the audience (at most 100,000).
ot.bc_text_hint: Each person reads the text of their own language. If a language is empty they get Arabic, then English, then Urdu. Write at least one.
ot.bc_link_hint: An in-app page, like /driver/opportunities. Tapping the notification opens it.
ot.bc_link_bad: Use an in-app path that starts with /
ot.bc_confirm: This will be sent to {n} people ({audience}). It cannot be recalled.
ot.bc_history_hint: Everything sent: audience, text, how many people got it and how many have read it.

lm.sms_off_hint: Text messages are switched off on the platform, so this parcel needs no delivery code. Scan or type the parcel code — that is the proof — and take a photo or a signature if the app asks for one.
lm.sms_off_resend: No code was sent because text messages are switched off. No code is needed.

ld.inv_confirm_hint: Confirm that the account registered under this name is the driver you invited. He can then accept the invitation.
